source: Brothers and sisters, have youseen this? The reason that God renews our heart and gives us a new heart at the time of our regeneration is that He wants us to incline toward Him, adore Him,desire Him,and love Him.Before,we did not love Him and we could not love Him, because our heart was old and hard. Now He has renewed, softened, and turned our heart; thus, we are both able and willing to love Him. Since our heart by being renewed has become a new heart, it now has a new function. This new function is that it can incline toward God and love God and the things of God.

source: Internal Debts: A sum of ₹ 2,429.00 crore is estimated to be received from Internal Debts of the State.Internal Debts include various loans such as Market Loans which is projected at ₹ 900.00 crore, NABARD Loan is kept at ₹ 170.00 crore, National Co-operative Development Corporation Loan capped at ₹ 5.00 crore, Rural Electricity Corporation at ₹ 2.00 crore, Power Financing Corporation loan estimated at ₹ 2.00 crore and SIDBI loan of ₹ 350.00 crore.The Government vows to continue rural infrastructure development works through NABARD loans.Some of the major projects approved for funding under NABARD RIDF XXVII are Construction of CHCs, PHCs etc. & for Infrastructure and Logistic Supplies for Fighting the Ongoing Covid Pandemic with a total project outlay of ₹ 27.25 crore, Upgradation of Existing 17.9 km Road to Cement Concrete Pavement from Meidum - Hortoki (Phase-II) with a project amount of ₹ 133.66 crore, Construction of Separate 11kV Feeders for Power Supply to Agricultural Lands amounting to ₹ 12.25 crore, Soil Conservation Measures for Enhancement of Productivity in Mizoram with a total project cost of ₹ 10.00 crore and Six Irrigation Projects in Mizoram with a project amount of ₹ 10.47 crore. The State is also committed to take up more rural development projects in the coming Financial Year.

source: HON'BLE UNION MINISTER SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA MEETS MAMIT DISTRICT OFFICIALS AND BENEFICIARIES. 83/2022-2023 Mamit 13th June, 2022: Shri PARSHOTTAM Rupala, Hon'ble Union Cabinet Minister, Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying today held a meeting with a District Officials and Beneficiaries of various centrally sponsor schemes at the conference hall of DC Mamit. The meeting was chaired by Pu Lalnunhlua DC Mamit. The Minister was appraised about the aspirational District programme undertakings and the present status in the delta ranking through power point presentation by Pu Lalsanglura, Nodal Officer of Aspirational District. Hon'ble Union Minister mentioned his purpose for his visited of the District and interaction with the Beneficiaries of various scheme. He assured full support for the proper implementation of the schemes so that the beneficiaries can enjoy the benefits as intended by the Government. In the meeting the Minister Interacted with the officials and beneficiaries of the following Central Scheme: AYUSHMAN BHARAT Health & Wellness, Ayushman Bharat Jan Arogya Yojana, e- Transaction, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), PM Street Vendor's Atma Nirbhar nidhi ( PM-Svanidhi), Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana ( Gramin/Urban), Jal Jeevan Mission ( Individual household connection & Schools), Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban/Gramin), PMMVY and PM-Kisan. Union minister is accompanied by the Director, Fisheries Department, Government of Mizoram and other Officials from Aizawl. Attachment Loading attachment...

source: DEO LAWNGTLAI PUBLISHES DRAFT ELECTORAL ROLL 2020 District Election Officer (DEO), Lawngtlai Pi Shashanka Ala, IAS published a draft electoral roll 2020 of three assembly constituencies within Lawngtlai District tomorow at her office chamber and handed over the draft electoral rolls to representatives of the political parties. As per the draft electoral roll, there are 31372 voters (15852 males and 15520 females) in 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C, 26926 voters (13524 males and 13402 females) in 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C and 24000 voters (11626 males and 12374 females) in 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C. In total, there are 82298 voters (41002 males and 41296 females) in Lawngtlai District. Claims and objections regarding the draft roll can be filed upto 15th January, 2020. The qualifying date for the roll is 1st January, 2020. Final electoral roll is scheduled to be published on 7th February, 2020. Meanwhile, 8 new polling stations in addition to the existing 62 stations in Tuichawng Constituency, 1 new polling station in addition to the existing 68 stations in Lawngtlai West Constituency and 7 new polling stations in addition to the existing 35 stations in Lawngtlai East Constituency are created resulting to the total number of 181 polling stations in Lawngtlai District. Draft roll hi political party ai awhte hnenah a hlan nghal. Draft electoral roll tlangzarh tak atanga a lan danin, 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C bialah vote nei mipa 15852 leh hmeichhia 15520, an vaiin mi 31372 an awm a; 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C bialah vote nei mipa 13524 leh hmeichhia 13402, an vaiin mi 26926 an awm a; 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C bialah voter mipa 11626 leh hmeichhia 12374, an vaiin mi 24000 an awm a; assembly bial pathumah hian vote nei mipa 41002 leh hmeichhia 41296, an vaiin mi 82298 an awm a ni. Summary revision neih turah hian sawi duh neite tan kum thar January ni 15 thleng hun hawn a ni a. February ni 7, 2020-ah final electoral roll chu tar chhuah tura tih a ni. Hemi rual hian Tuichawng biala polling station 62 awm saah a thar 8 hawn belh niin, polling station 70 a awm tawh dawn a; Lawngtlai West-a polling station awm sa 68-ah a thar 1 hawn belh niin, polling station 69 a awm tawh ang a; Lawngtlai East-a polling station awm sa 35 baka a thar hawn belh 7 nen polling station 42 awm tawhin, Lawngtlai District chhunga bial pathumah hian a vaiin polling station 181 a awm tawh dawn a ni. DEO LAWNGTLAI-IN 2020 ELECTORAL ROLL DRAFT A TICHHUAK

District Election Officer (DEO), Lawngtlai, Pi Shashanka Ala, IAS chuan nimin khan a office chamber-ah Lawngtlai District chhunga Assembly Constituency pathumte 2020 electoral roll draft a tichhuak a, political party aiawhte hnenah draft electoral roll-te chu a hlan bawk.

Draft electoral roll angin, 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C-ah voter 31372 an awm a, chung zinga mipa 15852 leh hmeichhia 15520 an ni. 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C-ah voter 26926 an awm a, chung zinga mipa 13524 leh hmeichhia 13402 an ni. 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C-ah voter 24000 an awm a, chung zinga mipa 11626 leh hmeichhia 12374 an ni. A vaiin Lawngtlai District-ah voter 82298 an awm a, chung zinga mipa 41002 leh hmeichhia 41296 an ni.

Draft roll chungchangah claim leh objection-te chu 15 January, 2020 thleng thehluh theih a ni. Roll-a qualifying date chu 1 January, 2020 a ni. Electoral roll hnuhnung ber chu 7 February, 2020-ah tichhuak tura ruahman a ni.

Hetih lai hian, Tuichawng Constituency-a polling station awmsa 62 bakah polling station thar 8 siam belh a ni a; Lawngtlai West Constituency-a polling station awmsa 68 bakah polling station thar 1 siam belh a ni bawk a; Lawngtlai East Constituency-a polling station awmsa 35 bakah polling station thar 7 siam belh a ni bawk. Chutiang chuan Lawngtlai District-a polling station zawng zawng zat chu 181 a tling ta.

“Happy Childhood” tih thupui hmanga, nimin khan Mamit-a GSA Playground-ah District Child Protection Unit, Mamit District-in naupangte tana Fun Day initiative programme angin Children’s Week chu an hawng a. Dr. R. Lalrinhlua, DCPO Mamit chuan Fun Day hi eng vangin nge buatsaih a nih tih a sawi a, naupangte chu an pianpui nihnaah an lo puitling theih nan nuam leh thil siam theihna lam hawi boruak siam a pawimawhzia a tarlang bawk. Aizawl, 11 May 2022; Hnuai-a tarlan ang hian, Mizoram Sawrkarin State Medical and Technical Entrance Examination (SMATEE) 2022 exam hun a sawn hnuh a ni. He Office Order No.A.45011/2/2021-JDT(HTE), Aizawl, 11 April 2022-a tihchhuah tawh angin, State Medical and Technical Entrance Examination (SMATEE) 2022 atan online application form thehluhna ni hnuhnung leh hun hnuhnung chu 3 June 2022 (Zirtawpni) zan dar 11:59 pm thlengin a sei belh a ni. Chu bakah, SMATEE 2022 exam neih hun pawh 17 June 2022 (Zirtawpni) zing dar 11:00 am atanga chawhnu dar 2:00 pm inkarah sawn hnuh a ni bawk.

source:
Not long after I was released from prison, I became
seriously ill with tuberculosis. I was confined to bed for six
months of absolute rest, followed by two and a half years
of greatly restricted activity for recovery. Outwardly speak-
ing, those days were really dark. But, I tell you, whenever
I prayed I felt that I was not in bed. but in the heavens.
Though I was gravely ill, yet when I prayed I had the sense
that I was not in illness, but far above it all in the heavens.
You do not know what kind of pleasure I had in the Lord
in those days. Imprisonment and persecution, then poverty
and illness. But, praise the Lord, the ascended Christ was
my way! The transcendent Christ was my way to the
heavens.

source: AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING INAUGURATED AT LUNGLEI No.523/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 28th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana on Saturday (26th February, 2022) inaugurated Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building at Electric Veng, Lunglei. The Rs. 1082.93 lakhs project is implemented under the NABARD, RIDF XXIII. Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng was the guest of honour at the inauguration. At the inaugural function chaired by Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi, Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana commended C&I Department staff, Electric veng YMA, VCs for their contribution towards successful completion of the project. As per Technical Report presented by AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl, the 5 floors Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building has a plinth area of 574.875 Square metres. The first floor is intended to be used as a training and awareness centre for agriculture marketing with an estimated capacity of 300 people, with guest rooms, conference/meeting rooms at the Ground floor. Basement I and Basement II contain the market areas and market offices, with a parking area at the basement.
reference: COMMERCE & INDUSTRIES MINISTER-IN LUNGLEIAH AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING HAWNG No.4122/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 26 th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana chuan vawiin khan Electric Veng, Lungleiah NABARD sum cheng nuai 1082.93 senga ruahman Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building a hawng. Hawnna inkhawm Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi kaihhruaiah Dr R Lalthangliana chuan Lunglei khawpui chhunga hmasawnna ruhrel liantham, khawtlang tana chhenfakawm tak leh eizawnna kawnga tangkai taka hman theih tur Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building zawhfel a ni chu lawmawm tiin a buaipuitu Commerce & Industries thawktute, building sa tu te leh Electric Veng Lunglei khawtlang te chungah lawmthu a sawi a. C&I Department hnuaiah hmalakna hrang hrang kalpui mek zel anih thu sawiin Lunglei Supermarket sakna tur cheng nuai 1400 NEC atanga sanction hmuh anih thu sawiin Bangladesh ram nena kan insumdawn tawnna atana ruahman Integrated Check Post (ICP), Kawrpuichhuah, Tlabung ti hlawhtling turin Department chuan theihtawp a chhuah mek zel thu a sawi a ni. A Department chan dangte hnuaia hmalaknte pawh sawilangin Minister chuan MZU Southern Campus atan DPR cheng vaibelchhe 400 sawrkar laipuiah thehluh tawh niin chak taka bawhzui mek a ni a, MZU Southern Campus tana hman lailawk tur Engineering College building chei that hna pawh thawh mek a ni, a ti a. Civil Hospital Lungleia Trauma Centre sak pawh zawh fel thuai beisei anih thu sawiin Multipurpose Laboratory Building, NEC sum cheng nuai 300 a ruahman mek pawh nakum kum tir lama zawhfel beisei anih thu a sawi. Lunglei Municipal Council (LMC) chungchang pawh sawiin Minister chuan Municipal body chak tak enkawlna hnuaiah Lunglei khawpui chuan kawng hrang hrangin hmasawnna a nei dawn a ni, a ti. He huna khualzahawm Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng chuan Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building hawn theiha peih fel a ni ta chu Pathian malsawmna ropui tak a ni tiin he hmasawnna ruhrel neih theihna tura sulsutute thawhrimna leh thahnemngaihna rah a ni, a ti a. He building ti hlawhtling tura bultan tu Pu Joseph Lalhimpuia chungah leh a hmun phal taka petu Electric Veng YMA te chungah lawmthu a sawi a ni. He building sak enkawltu AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl atangin Technical Report ngaihtlak a ni a. Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure hi NABARD, RIDF XXIII hnuaia project niin total project cost hi Rs. 1082.93 lakhs ani a. Hna hi 05/10/2018 ah thawh tan a ni. A building plinth area hi 574.875 Square metres niin building hi floor nga (5) a sak a ni a. First floor hi Agriculture leh marketing lama training leh awareness centre atan ruahman niin mihring 300 vel leng tura hisap a ni. Ground floor ah hian guest room, conference/meeting room te awmin Basement I ah hian mi 78 lenna market area bakah market office ruamhan niin Basement II ah mi 85 lenna market area niin Basement III hi motor 25 lenna parking area-a ruahman a ni. No.612/2020-2021  
Aizawl, 15th March, 2021 : Mizoram Rajya Sabha MP K. Vanlalvena chuan tun hian Rajya Sabha Chairman leh India Vice President Shri Venkaiah Naidu chu a official inah a hmu a, Myanmar rama buaina nasa tak thleng mekah remna leh muanna siamthat lehna atan Central sorkar inrawlhna a ngen a; tin, sipai junta-in Myanmar sorkar an lakluh hnu-a democracy, mihring dikna leh rorêlna tana dingtute chungah tihduhdahna nasa tak an tih avanga international border rawn kan tlang a Mizoram-ah himna zawngtute Myanmar mihringte tana puihna leh tanpuina ruahmanna siam tur pawh a ngen bawk.

Vice President a hmuha an inkawmnaah chuan Vanlalvena hi MNF party Adviser Rosangzuala’n a tawiawm a. An pahnih hian Myanmar dinhmun chu a tha loh zawng zawngin a zual deuh deuh thei tih an ngaihtuahna an sawi a. Protest-a tel mi tam tak an thi tawh a, tam zawk leh an hliam bawk a; protest-a tel mi tam tak chu dik lo taka man leh tan in an ni bawk.

Dinhmun hlauhawm tak chu ngaihtuahin, Vanlalvena chuan Central sorkar chu Myanmar mite tana ding turin a ngen a, Myanmar lam hawi foreign policy pawh en thar leh a, ram chhunga remna leh inpumkhatna siamthat lehna tur kawng zawng turin a ngen bawk.

No.342/2021-2022
Aizawl
8th October, 2021

Pradhan Mantri Van Dhan Yojana (PMVDY) hnuaia Van Dhan Vikas Kendra (VDVK) Level Advocacy Programme chu Mamit District-a Kawrthah khuaa SSA Block Resource Centre-ah, Mamit District Cooperative Officer Pu Lalthangfala hruainain neih a ni.

Kawrthah VDVK Centre hnuaiah Kawrthah cluster-a hmeichhia hnam hrang hrang mi 300-te chu tailoring zirna pek an ni ang.

Mamit District Cooperative Office ruahmanin PMVDY hnuaia VDVK chungchang hriatna programme chu zirlaite tana neih a ni.

source: a) Post Devolution Revenue Deficit Grants: Revenue Deficit Grants are released as monthly installments to 17 States as per the recommendations of the Fifteenth Finance Commission to meet the gap in Revenue Accounts of the States post devolution.States which still show revenue deficit post devolution are recommended Revenue Deficit Grants. The Centre has put an estimated amount of ₹ 1,615.00 crore for 2022-23 as recommended by the Fifteenth Finance Commission which is 9.78% lower than the current year’s BE.The recommended Revenue Deficit Grants diminish towards the end of the Finance Commission award period with only ₹ 586.00 crore recommended for 2025-26.

source: MIZORAM CHIEF SECRETARY LEADS GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES IN TAKING INTEGRITY PLEDGE 275/2023-2024 Vigilance Awareness Week, 2023 is to be observed in the whole of India from today, i.e. 30th October till 5th November, 2023. This year the theme is - 'Say no to corruption, commit to the Nation'. Starting off the Vigilance Week in Mizoram too, Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma led the officials and staff of the Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO this morning in taking the 'Integrity Pledge' in the Secretariat Courtyard. Likewise, all Heads of Offices under the State Government also led the employees in their respective offices in taking the Integrity Pledge, in which each government servant avowed to follow probity and rule of law in all walks of life, to neither take nor offer bribe, to perform all tasks in an honest and transparent manner, to act in public interest, to lead by example exhibiting integrity in personal behavior and to report any incident of corruption to the appropriate agency. Kumin Vigilance Week thupui chu - 'Hlemhletna hnawl la, ram tan thawk rawh' (Say no to corruption, commit to the Nation) a ni. Ram hmundangte rualin vawiin chawhma khan Mizoramah pawh 'Vigilance Week 2023' hawn nan Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma kaihhruaina hnuaiah Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO-a sorkar hnathawk, officials and staff zawng zawngten a huhovin 'Integrity Pledge' thuchham an chham rual a. Sorkar office tina Heads of Office-te pawhin an hnuaia thawk officer leh staff-te nen anmahni office hmun theuhah 'Integrity Pledge' hi an chhamrual bawk a ni. MIZORAM CHIEF SECRETARY-IN Sawrkar hnathawkte a hruaiin rinawmna thutiam an siam

275/2023-2024

Vigilance Awareness Week, 2023 hi tunin, a ni chu 30 October atanga 5 November, 2023 thlengin India ram pumah hman tur a ni. Kumina thupui chu - “Corruption chu ti lo ula, ram tana inpêk rawh u” tih a ni.

Mizoram-ah pawh Vigilance Week hawnna atan, Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma-in vawiin zingah Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO-a officer leh staff-te a hruaiin Secretariat Courtyard-ah “Integrity Pledge” an siamtir a ni.

Chutiang bawkin, State Government hnuaia Office hrang hrang hotute pawhin an office hrang hrangah hnathawkte a hruaiin Integrity Pledge an siamtir vek a. He thutiamah hian sawrkar hnathawk tinte chuan nun kawng zawng zawngah dikna leh dan zawmna an zawm ang, ruihhlo an la dawn lo vang a, an pe dawn lo vang, hnathawh zawng zawng rinawm tak leh lang tlang taka an ti ang, mipui thatna atan an chet ang, mi mal nungchangah rinawmna lantirin entawn tlak takin an nung ang, tin, corruption thil thleng apiang chu agency dik tak hnenah an report ang tih an tiam a ni.

source: HEALTH MINISTER DR. R. LALTHANGLIANA FLAGGED OFF 11 MOBILE MEDICAL VAN IN MAMIT DISTRICT No.541/2020-2021 Dr. R. Lalthangliana Health Minister flagged off 11 Bolero Campers designed for Mobile medical van to be used in rural areas of Mamit Aspiration District. Health Minister specially thank REC Ltd for their selfless help through their CSR initiatives in fostering aspiring district like Mamit which would help them aspire i in various development fields. Bolero Camper (4WD BS6) 11 nos were bought for - Rs. 1,04,50,000/- under REC Ltd. CSR initiative as reported by Nodal Officer Beitlotha Nohro. Also Laptop & Speaker consisting of 52 nunbers worth Rs. 24,60,000/- was also handed over by the minister to CMO and DMS Mamit District hospital. Essential Drugs & Diagnostic kits 76 nos - worth Rs.15,60,000/- and Folic Acid, Oral rehydration salt, Ibuprofen, Ascorbic Acid (vitamin C), Albendazole, Paracetamol and other Diagnostic Kits of 50 nos and Sahli's Haemoglobinometer, Pregnancy Test Kit, Malaria Test Kit, Typhoid Test Kit, BP Instrument Mercurial, Adult Weighing Machine, Hepatitis B-Test Kit etc were given out in the same programme. Er. H. Lalzirliana, Mamit A/C MLA, Pu C. Lalrammawia, Chairman ZOHANCO, Health Department Officials and NGOs and Village Council leaders were present at the programme. The Flagged off programme was chaired by the DC Mamit himself Dr. Lalrozama IAS. Attachment Loading attachment...
reference: HEALTH MINISTER-IN MAMIT DISTRICT CHHUNGA HMAN TUR MOBILE MEDICAL VAN LEH HMANRAW DANGTE VAILIAM No.7589/2020-2021 Vawiin khan Dr. R. Lalthangliana, Minister, Health & Family Welfare Department, Higher & Technical Education, Commerce & Industries chuan Mobile Medical Van, Essential Drugs & Diagnostic Kits & Laptops and Speaker Mamit District Hospital, PHC/CHC leh Sub- Centre-a hman tur vailiam. Khuallian Dr. R Lalthangliana chuan Mamit District chhunga cheng te'n hriselna kawnga hma an sawn theihna tura hmanraw tangkai tak taka thuam an ni chu a lawmawm thusawiin District - 11 zinga Medical Doctor ngei District Bawrhsap, hriselna kawnga a ngaihna hria in nei chu in vannei takzet a. Aspirational District atangin Mizoram District 11- te zingah pakhatna ni thei tura tan la tura chahin in tum tlat chuan theihloh a awm lo a ni tiin kum zabi 21-a hmasawnna chu hmang tangkaiin dik taka kan hmachhawn chuan District hnufual ber thin kha a ropui ber kan ni thei a ni a ti. Dr. Thangtea chuan Pathian ringtu mizo nih hi a nuama, pi leh pute atanga lungrual tak leh inpumkhatna nena thawkho thin kan nihna chuan rah tha chhuah zelin, Covid - 19 avanga nunna chan kan nei erawh pawi hle rualin hri dona kawnga kan hmalakna-a hlawhtlinna kan hmuh mekte leh India hmarchhak State pariat (8) zingah Covid - 19 vanga thi tlemna ber State kan ni chu Pathian avang leh kan thawhhona avang a ni a ti. Minister chuan hmasawnna kan hmuh mekte chu chho zawnga thlira in delhbeh tir mai lovin hmasawnna tluantling nei turin kan tih ve theih tawk theuha tan la thar turin kalkhawmte a fuih a. Kawngpui tha nei turin hmalakna kalpui mek niin khawchhak lam atanga khawthlang lam hawiin kawngsial hna thawh tan mek a nih thu a sawi bawk. Er. H. Lalzirliana, Bialtu MLA pawhin Mamit District-in hriselna kawnga hma kan sawn theihna tur leh Aspirational District kan nihna atanga khaichhuah kan nihna tura CSR hnuai atanga hmanraw tangkai tak tak lei a ni chu lawmawm a tih thusawiin Kan District Bawrhsap-in hemi kawnga hma a lakna chu fakawm a tih thu a sawi a. Covid-19 hripuiin khawvel a tih buai mek karah Mizoram chu Sorkar hmalakna chak tak a vang te, Kohhran mite tawngtaina vang te leh khawtlang hruaitute hmalakna avangin India ram state zingah a titha ber pawl kan ni chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk. Bialtu MLA chuan Mamit District-in kawngpui tha kan neih chu Mizoram Sawrkarin a ngaihpawimawh berte zing a mi a nih avangin chak taka hmalakna kalpui a ni a, hun reilote-ah kawngpui tha kan nei thuai a beisei thu a sawi. Mamit District-in hriselna lama hma kan sawna, nu naupai te'n enkawlna tha zawk an dawn a, damdawi an mamawh angte an hmuh theihna tur bakah damlote enkawlna tha zawk leh rang zawk pek an nih theihna tura District chhung PHC/CHC leh Health Sub- Centre-te tana hmanraw lei hi Mamit District Bawrhsap hmalakna-in REC LTD, CSR Health Project hnuai atanga lei a ni. Vawiin-a sem tak Bolero Camper(4WD BS6) 11 lei nan hian Rs. 1,04,50,000/- hman niin Motor-te hi Health Care delivery a bik takin vaccination drive, Health camp conduct leh awareness pekna tur bakah, kawng that lohna hmun, motor naran in a thlen theih lohna khuate awlsam taka thlen theihnan 4 wheeled drive lei a ni a. Rs. 15,60,000/- senga lei damdawi chi hrang hrang 76 - Folic Acid, Oral rehydration salt, Ibuprofen, Ascorbic Acid (vitamin C), Albendazole, Paracetamol leh Diagnostic Kits 50 - Sahli's Haemoglobinometer, Pregnancy Test Kit, Malaria Test Kit, Typhoid Test Kit, BP Instrument Mercurial, Adult Weighing Machine, Hepatitis B-Test Kit leh a dangte Sub Centre/Health & Wellness Centre- te hman tur khuallian hian a hlan bawk. He Project hian a tum ber chu Health & welness Centre hi mi tam zawkin health care services an dawn theihna tur leh a tlawhtute mamawh damdawi leh diagnostic kit te a thlawna pek chhuah a ni a, health and welness centre hi mi tam zawkin hmang tangkaia, an tlawh tam (footfall) nana kalpui a ni. Vawiin vek hian Rs. 24,60,000/- senga lei Laptop leh Speaker 52, Mamit District chhung khua tlawh pawh harsa leh health care facility nei thalo khuate tan awlsam zawka health care provider te an biak pawh zung zung theihna turin Telemedicine atan Health Department hnenah hlan a ni bawk. He hun hi Dr. Lalrozama, IAS, Deputy Commissioner chuan kaihruaiin, Pu Beitlotha Nohro, SDC pawhin report pe-in Health Project hnuaiah Aspirational District kan nih avanga hriselna lama hma kan sawn theihna tura thuam kan nih dante a tarlang a. Dr. Vanlalfela, Chief Medical Officer, Mamit-in lawmthu sawina a nei bawk. Minister hi Er. H. Lalzirliana, 3-Mamit Bialtu MLA, Pu C. Lalrammawia, Chairman, ZOHANCO, Health Department Officials, Mamit khawpui chhunga Head of Offices bakah khawtlang hruaitute'n leh thutharthehdarhtute'n an tawiawm a ni. raw_text:
MAMIT DISTRICT-A MOBILE MEDICAL VAN 11 TE Health Minister Dr. R. Lalthangliana-IN A THLAK CHHUAK

No.541/2020-2021

Health Minister Dr. R. Lalthangliana chuan Mamit Aspiration District khawpui lo leh thingtlang hmunah hman tur Mobile Medical Van atan siam Bolero Camper 11 a thlak chhuak. Health Minister chuan REC Ltd chu an CSR initiative hmangin Mamit ang district hmasawn duh takte tan an puihna rilru thianghlim avangin lawmthu a sawi a, hei hian hmasawnna kawng hrang hrangah an hma lak theihna a pui dawn tih a sawi bawk.

Nodal Officer Beitlotha Nohro report angin, Bolero Camper (4WD BS6) 11 hi REC Ltd. CSR initiative hnuaiah Rs. 1,04,50,000/- manin lei a ni. Chu bakah, Laptop leh Speaker 52, a man Rs. 24,60,000/- chu Minister chuan CMO leh DMS, Mamit District Hospital hnenah a hlan bawk.

Essential Drugs leh Diagnostic Kits 76, a man Rs. 15,60,000/- te leh Folic Acid, Oral Rehydration Salt, Ibuprofen, Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Albendazole, Paracetamol leh Diagnostic Kits dang 50, tin, Sahli's Haemoglobinometer, Pregnancy Test Kit, Malaria Test Kit, Typhoid Test Kit, BP Instrument Mercurial, Adult Weighing Machine, Hepatitis B-Test Kit leh a dangte pawh programme vekah sem chhuah a ni bawk.

Programme-ah hian Er. H. Lalzirliana, Mamit A/C MLA, Pu C. Lalrammawia, Chairman, ZOHANCO, Health Department official-te, NGO-te leh Village Council hruaitute an tel a. Flagged off programme hi DC Mamit, Dr. Lalrozama, IAS ngeiin a kaihruai.

source:
Perhaps you will say to me, “Brother, I know I have to
be limited all the time. I must be limited by my wife, by
my children, by my boss, by the brothers, and especially
by a certain brother. I am limited by this, and I am limited by
that; all day I am limited. And I expect tomorrow and the
next day to be worse. How can I meet the situation? I realize
that the resurrected Christ is living in me, but I have so little
of Him. I don’t even have five loaves; I just have one loaf.”

source: MYC CHAIRMAN LAYS FOUNDATION STONE FOR MYC INCUBATION CENTRE AT SERKAWN, LUNGLEI No.573/2021-2022 Aizawl the 28th March, 2022 : MYC Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia, Lunglei North MLA laid the foundation stone for Mizoram Youth Commission Incubation Centre at Serkawn,Lunglei near Lena Stadium on Saturday (26th March, 2022). The land for the Incubation Centre was donated by Serkawn VC. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Pu H. Lalnunzuala, Under Secretary MYC, Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub-Headquarters Lunglei and representatives from Serkawn locality and various NGOs were also present at the occasion. On the occasion of this foundation stone laying ceremony, MYC Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia said this centre would cater to the needs of aspiring Mizo youths such as competitive coaching, Information Technology, skill development and entrepreneurship. He thanked the local leaders of Serkawn who donated the property to MYC, and promised them that the centre would be used for the betterment of society and the economy. Talking about the MYC Coaching Centres in Lunglei, Siaha, Kolasib Districts and the one in Champhai which will be opened shortly, the MYC Chairman said that he along with the MYC team would continue working in earnest for the advancement of Mizo youths to the best of their capabilities. He stated that construction of MYC Youth Centres are underway at Aizawl,Serchhip and Lunglei. In addition to competitive exams, MYC is planning to continue to provide cement mistiri training, food processing training, cake baking training, cabin crew, Army Pre-Recruitment training and promotion of music and sports to help the youths reach their goals at the national level. The MYC Chairman said that the MYC Super IAS 20 which was started in 2020 will be upgraded to Super IAS 40 which will comprise of 20 more aspirants. He further said that the road connecting Khawiva, Aizawl-Thenzawl-Lunglei road and roads in Lunglei town will be repaired and that the budget for the improvement works for MZU Southern Campus is raised to Rs.15 crore. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng shared that although the staff of MYC are few in number, their contributions to the future of Mizo youths are commendable. He stated his appreciation for the Incubation Centre and urged the people to make the most out of this centre. Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub-Headquarters Lunglei and Pu K. Zodinsanga, VCP Serkawn also gave a brief speech, Pu Lalmuanzuala, CC, MYC Lunglei ended the ceremony with vote of thanks speech. Attachment Loading attachment...

A sawi zel naah MYC Chairman chuan Mizo thalaite hmasawnna turin MYC chuan theihtawp a chhuah zel dawn a ni tiin Lunglei, Siaha leh Kolasib District -ah te MYC Coaching Centre hawn tawh niin Champhai ah pawh hawn leh thuai tum a ni a. source: FINAL ELECTORAL ROLLS FOR BY-ELECTION TO TOKALO MDC CONSTITUENCY PUBLISHED District Election Officer & Deputy Commissioner of Siaha District, Shri.Bhupesh Chaudhary IAS published and handed over Final E/Rolls for By-Election to Tokalo MDC Constituency, to the representatives of various Political Parties in Hard & Soft copy, at his office chamber, here at Siaha tomorrow. Tokalo MDC constituency was declared as vacant constituency due to the untimely demise of its incumbent MDC Shri. K.L Bana and his Death prompted a By-Election. Basing 1st January, 2019 as qualifying date, a Summary Revision of E/Rolls had been be carried out smoothly as per the Schedule prescribed by SEC. Final E/Rolls Publication event was attended by: Shri.K.Vanlalthiana,Addl.DC, Shri. Amol Srivastava IAS, Asst.Commissioner, H.Zonunmawia, Election Officer, Shri. N.Vabeiratlua, DIPRO,Representatives of MTP(H), MCHP(H) and various Political Parties. A just published Final E/Rolls consisted of 450 female voters and 505 male voters, totalling to 955 voters in all. Attachment Loading attachment...
reference: TOKALO MDC CONSTITUENCY BY- ELECTION A HMAN TUR FINAL ELECTORAL ROLLS TLANGZARH Nimin (15.10.2019) chawhnu dar 1:00Pm khan District Election Officer leh Bawrhsap ni bawk Pu Bhupesh Chaudhary IAS chuan a office chamber-ah Tokalo Constituency a MDC By-Election neih huna hman tur Final E/Rolls a tlangzarhin, political party hrang hrang aiawhte hnenah Final E/Rolls chu a Hard leh Soft Copy in a hlan nghal hlawm a ni. Tokalo bialtu MDC Pu K.L Bana a boral tak avanga By-Election hi neih tur a ni. 1st January, 2019 hi qualifying date a hmangin, State Election Commission duan angin Summary Revision of E/Rolls hi tluang taka kalpui niin, vawiin hi Final E/Rolls tlangzarh tura ni ruat a ni. Final E/Rolls tlangzarhna-ah hian Pu K.Vanlalthiana,Addl.DC, Pu Amol Srivastava IAS,Asst.Commissioner, Pu H.Zonunmawia, Election Officer, Pu N.Vabeiratlua, DIPRO, Tlawmngai Pawl MTP(H) leh MCHP(H) aiawh te leh Political Party hrang hrang aiawhte an tel a ni. TOKALO MDC CONSTITUENCY-a BY-ELECTION atan FINAL ELECTORAL ROLLS tihchhuah a ni

Siaha District Election Officer leh Deputy Commissioner, Shri Bhupesh Chaudhary IAS chuan Tokalo MDC Constituency-a By-Election atan Final E/Rolls chu political party hrang hrang aiawhte hnenah hard copy leh soft copy-in a office chamber-ah, Siaha-ah, nimin a tihchhuah a ni a, a hlan bawk.

Tokalo MDC Constituency chu a incumbent MDC Shri K.L Bana thih hman loh vangin seat ruak a ni tih puan a ni a, a thihna chuan By-Election neih a ngaihtir a ni.

1st January, 2019 chu qualifying date atan hmangin, SEC-in schedule a ruat angin E/Rolls Summary Revision chu hmanhmawh lo takin tihfel taka kalpui a ni.

Final E/Rolls tihchhuahna inkhawm chu heng mite hian an tel a: Shri K. Vanlalthiana, Addl. DC; Shri Amol Srivastava IAS, Asst. Commissioner; H. Zonunmawia, Election Officer; Shri N. Vabeiratlua, DIPRO; MTP(H), MCHP(H) leh political party hrang hrang aiawhte.

Final E/Rolls thar tihchhuah chu hmeichhia vote nei 450 leh mipa vote nei 505 a awm a, a vaiin voter 955 an ni.

source: SPORTS MINISTER LAUDS MIZORAM GIRLSâ€™ VICTORY IN NES U-19 FOOTBALL CHAMPIONSHIP Headquarters 23 Sector Assam Rifles today organised a felicitation programme at Loch Hall within the precincts of 46 Assam Rifles, Aizawl for team members of the Mizoram U-19 Girls Team who recently lifted the Assam Rifles organized North East States Under-19 Championship held during July 17-21 at Diphu and Kohima. Speaking on the occasion, the Minister highlighted the role football has played in connecting the North Eastern states with the rest of the country and said that it is an important tool in strengthening national integration and in helping the region mainstream with the rest of the country. Appreciating the cooperation between the Mizoram Government and Mizoram Football Association (MFA) in furthering the cause of football, the Minister expressed hope that this partnership will grow stronger and reach new heights in the coming days. He said that the Government will support MFA and other sports organizations and associations in all the possible way whether through financial assistance or otherwise. He pointed that for the first time ever Mizoram will soon have a comprehensive sports policy â€˜Mizoram Sports Policyâ€™ and through this policy Mizoram will achieve accolades in sports, he added. The Minister also spelt out new initiatives in the pipeline for development of football in the state and said that Flood Lighting and other works of Rajiv Gandhi Stadium to meet international standards will soon be completed. INDIA rama Vatican thawnthu hrilh tûr Apostolic Nuncio-in MIZORAM Governor a kawm

Archbishop Salvatore Pennacchio, Vatican-in India rama a thawn Apostolic Nuncio chuan, nimin khân Raj Bhavan-ah Mizoram Governor Lt. Gen. (Rtd.) Nirbhay Sharma a kawm a, India mipuite hnêna Vatican thiltum ṭha tak a puan a ni. Vatican Ambassador, Mizoram a rawn tlawh hmasa ber chuan, sawrkarin remna siam tûra an thawh rim tak chu a fak hle. Mizoram state-a remna leh inpumkhatna awm avângin a host pawh a lawmawm thu a sawi bawk a, khawvel mipui pung zêl tana hygiene tha zawk neih theih nân tun hunah mamawh tak ni anga a ngaih, boruak fai leh thianghlim chungchang pawh a fak nasa hle.

General Sharma chuan, Mizoram aiawhin, Holy See diplomat-in a lo tlawh ve hi a lawmawm thu a sawi a. Mizoram hi India hmun dangte tân remna leh inpumkhatna kawnga entawn tlâk state a nih thu a pawm chungin, state sawrkarin remna vawn tûra NGO chak takte, Kohhrante leh civil society-te’n hlutna tak an neih thu chu a lo tlawhtu hriattîr a ni. Tin, Archbishop Salvatore Pennacchio anga kohhran hotu zahawm tak pakhatin sawrkar leh mipuite hmasawnna tûra kohhrante thawhpuina tam zawk an pe theih nân ngenna siam se a hlawk hle ang tih pawh a sawi bawk. India ram hi pluralism chungah a ding a, India chakna chu a hnam leh a nunphung hrang hrangah a awm tih pawh a tarlang. Chumi hnuah chuan, India rama sakhua hrang hrangte inkara inlaichînna tha leh inpawmtawnna vawn nunpui tûrin a lo tlawhtu chu thawh ho tûrin a sawm a ni.

source: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visits Sainik School Chhingchhip 191/2022-2023 Chhingchhip, the 30th September 2022: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati who is on an official tour of Serchhip District visited Sainik School, Chhingchhip, a few miles away from Serchhip town today. Upon his arrival, Governor was accorded the Guard of Honour by 8 Bn of Assam Rifles. He was then introduced to the staff by Wcdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, and Maj S.Kalyan, Administrative Officer. A briefing about the School to Governor was given by the Principal in his office room. After this, an official function with a cultural program was organized inside the Assembly Hall in honour of the esteemed visitor. Here, the Governor addressed the students. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati congratulated faculties for their best effort to keep up with other establishwd Sainik Schools in the country. He thanked the state government for bring up a highly valuable asset of national importance in education like Sainik school here in Mizoram. He expressed his pride of having the first Sainik School in the country where girl students are admitted. He stressed the importance of Sainik Schools for preparing the young students to become cadet officers in Army, Airforces and Navy. Beside this, he said the school also prepared the students to become role model students and role model citizen. He reminded the students of the school about their important duties for the national integration of the county. Full speech of the Honble Governor : https://dipr.mizoram.gov.in/post/speech-of-dr-hari-babu-kambhampati-honble-governor-of-mizoram-on-the-occasion-of-visit-to-sainik-school-chhingchhip-on-30th-september-2022 The programme began with welcome address by Maj S.Kalyan, Admn and concluded with vote of thanks proposed by WCdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, Sainik School, Chhingchhip. After the official programme, Governor inspected the facilities inside the campus of Sainik School Chhingchhip. As per the briefing by the Principal, here are the few highlights of the school. The school is now 6 years old and running with the pilot cadets in Class XI. The annual intake of students are 60 boys and 10 girls in the class VI while in the class IX only boys are admitted with the availability of 10 seats for students annually. The annual fee per a student is estimated at Rs 1.85 lakh per year. The schools have daily routine for winter and summer and winter with the physical and classroom activities through out the day. It usually starts from very early morning till 9:00 to 9:30 PM at night. Apart from the facilities for cocurricular activities, the School is also currently having the facilities like Football Ground, Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Gynasium, Music room,etc.,. The swimming pool, parade ground and other big sports facilities are being planned to be added very soon. The Principal highlighted the status of Grant in Aid from the state, issues with water and power bills, LMV ambulance to be received from the Mizoram Rural Bank through CSR, INSAS rifles to be received from Home Department, Government of Mizoram, Infrastructural Fund received to the tune of Rs 99,96,000 the Ministry of Defence with the proposed implementations. To solve the issue with high power bills, the Governor advised implementation of Solar Power Generation plant inside the campus. While, the issue with high water bills is being taken up the office Deputy Commissioner and is expected to be solved very soon. Governor in his visit to Sainik School, Chhingchhip was escorted and given a company by Pu Lalmuansanga Ralte, Addl DC and Pu Stephen Lalrinawma, SP, Serchhip District. He hunah hian School building leh hmunhma te a endik a, Sikul naupangte hmaah fuihna thu a sawi bawk a ni. Governor hian Sainik School a thlenin amah zahna chibai 8 Bn Assam Rifles ten School kawtah an lo buk a. Wcdr Shahul Hameed, Principal leh Maj S.Kalyan, Administrative Officer ten zirtirtute leh School staff te an hmelhriattir chhunzawm a. Hemi zawh hian Principal Office ah Sainik School dinhmunte inhrilhhriatna hun neih leh a ni a. Assembly Hall-ah Official programme leh Cultural Programme neih chhunzawm nghal a ni. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Principal leh a thawhpui ten Sainik School tha tak ni tur leh hmun danga Sainik School te dinhmun pha tura theihtawp an chhuah chu fakawm a tih thu a sawi hmasa a. Mizoram sawrkarin hetiang ang School tha bik Mizorama zirlaite tan a buatsaih thei chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk a ni. Sainik School Chhingchhip hi India ram hmundang te aia a danglam bik na chu helai hmunah hian Sainik School dangte entawn turin a vawikhatna atana leh a hmahruaitu ni turin hmeichhe naupangte luh tir an ni a. Hei hi a chhuanawm tak zet a ni a ti. Sainik School te hi khawi hmunah pawh School thabik an ni a, Sipai, Navy leh Airforce Officer ni turin a bik takin heng schoolah te hian zirlai te zirtirna pek a ni a ti. Sainik School a zirlaite hi Armed Forces ah an thawkvek kher lo a nih pawhin khawtlang leh ram tana khua leh tui entawn tlak ni tura chher an nih thu a sawi bawk. India chakna chu danglamna tam tak kara inpumkhatna leh inunauna tha a ni tih zirlaite chu a hrilh nawn leh a. He mawhphurhna huangah hian Sainik School zirlaite chu hmahruaitu ni turin a chah a ni. Official programme zawh hian Saini School Campus chhunga School building leh hmunhma te Governor chuan a endik chhunzawm nghal a ni. Principal Report atanga a lan dan chuan Sainik School Chhingchhip hi kum 6 hmel a hmu mek a. Tunah hian batch hmasa ber(Class VI) te chu Class XI an ni mek a ni. School naupangte hian zing dar 5 vel atangin zan dar 9:30 vel thleng nitin, lehkha zirna hun, infiamna leh thildang tangkai zir nan hun an hmang thin a. Lehkha zirna leh a kaihhnaih(cocurricular activities) bakah zirlaite tan hian taksa insawizawina leh themthiamna chidangte ( extracurricular activities) atana hmunhma pawimawh Football Ground, Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Gynasium, Music room,etc., te he school hian a nei a. Swimming pool, parade ground leh sports facility tangkai tak tak buatsaih chhoh zel a tum bawk. Principal hian Mizoram sawrkar in tanpuina a pek thin - GIA dinhmun te, Ambulance te chi MRB in CSR kaltlanga pek a tum chungchang te, NCC te tana tangkai INSAS silai Home Department, Govt of Mizoram in pek a tum chunchang te Rs 99,96,000 school tihphuisuina atana Ministry of Defence atang sum lo kal tur chungchangte a sawi a. An harsatna pahnih Tui Bill sang tak leh Electric chhit man sang lutuk chungchangte pawh sawi a ni. Kawlphetha a harsatna sutkian a nih theih nan campus chhunga Solar Power Generation Plant bun turin Governor chuan Sainik School Chhingchhip hotute chu thurawn a pe a. Tui bill chungchang pawh Serchhip DC office leh PHED ten chinfel sak turin hma an la mek tih sawi a ni. raw_text:
Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati-a’n Sainik School Chhingchhip a tlawh

191/2022-2023  
Chhingchhip, 30 September 2022: Serchhip District-a official tour nei mek Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati-a’n tûnah hian Serchhip khawpui atanga mile eng emaw zat hlaa awm Sainik School, Chhingchhip a tlawh a. A lo thlen hnuah Assam Rifles 8 Bn-in Guard of Honour an pe a. Chumi hnuah WCdr Shahul Hameed, Principal leh Maj S. Kalyan, Administrative Officer-te’n school staff-te chu Governor hnenah an hrilh a. Principal-in a office room-ah Governor hnenah school chungchang tawi fel takin a hrilhfiah bawk.

Hei hnuah hian Assembly Hall chhûnga mi zahawm tak lawmna atan cultural programme tel official function buatsaih a ni a. Hetah hian Governor-in zirlaite a sawm a. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati-a’n ram pum huapa Sainik School din tawh dangte nena intluk theihna atan an theih ang anga an thawh nasa avangin zirtirtu leh faculty-te a lawmpui a. Mizoram-ah hian Sainik School ang education lama ram tana hlu tak din chhuahnaah state sorkar chu a lawm thu a sawi bawk. Ram pum huapa Sainik School-ah hmeichhia zirlaite pawh luh theihna hmasa ber neitu nih avangin a lawmna leh a chhuangna a puang a. Army, Air Force leh Navy-a cadet officer an lo nih theihna atan naupang zirlaite buatsaihnaah Sainik School-te pawimawhna a sawi uar a. Chu bakah school hian zirlaite chu role model student leh role model citizen an nih theihna atan pawh a buatsaih tih a sawi. School zirlaite hnenah ram pum huap inpumkhatna atan an mawhphurhna pawimawh tak a awm tih a hriattir bawk.

source: ASSAM RIFLES BATTALION TO CONDUCT 8TH ROZGAR MELA FOR MIZORAM STATE 195/2023-2024 Aizawl the 26th August, 2023 - Battalion of Headquarters Inspector General Assam Rifles (East) will be conducting 8th Rozgar Mela on 28 August 2023 at 2 AR Gajraj Hall, Lakhimpur Battalion. A large number of individuals will be benefitted by the Mela. Central Government is set to organize the 8th Job Fair on 28 August 2023. This event, spanning over 25 states and more than 44 locations, will see the distribution of appointment letters to approximately 70,000 young individuals of various Departments of the Indian Government. Notably, our Honorable Prime Minister Narendra Modi will preside over the event, addressing the youth through live streaming, followed by the distribution of appointment letter to the candidates present. Assam Rifles is playing a pivotal role in organizing the Rozgar Mela for the state of Mizoram and overseeing the eventâ€™s coordination. The Honorable Minister of Minority Affairs, Mr John Barla will personally hand over appointment letter to the candidates. The Honorable Prime Minister will witness the ceremony via Video Conferencing. The Rozgar Mela is a step towards fulfillment of the duty of Government to accord highest priority to employment generation.
reference: ASSAM RIFLES BATTALION-IN ROZGAR MELA BUATSAIH DAWN 1663/2023-2024 Aizawl, the 26th August, 2023: Headquarters Inspector General Assam Rifles (East) hnuaia Assam Rifles Battalion chuan August ni 28, 2023 hian Rozgar Mela/Job Fair tum 8-na 2 AR Gajraj Hall, Lakhimpur Battalion, Aizawl-ah a buatsaih dawn. Sawrkar laipui ruahmannain Rozgar Mela/Job Fair chu August ni 28, Thawhtanni hian State hrang hrang 25 a hmun 44 ahte huaihawt a ni dawn a. He hunah hian Indian Government hnuai Department hrang hranga hna hmu thar mi 70,000 dawnte hnenah appointment letter pek chhuah a ni ang. Prime Minister Pu Narendra Modi chuan ram pum huap hun hman hi a kaihruai dawn a, live streaming kaltlangin thalaite hnena thuchah a sawi hnuah hna hmu thar a hmuna awmte hnenah appointment letter a sem chhuak dawn a ni. Mizorama Rozgar Mela/Job Fair hlawhtling taka huaihawt a nih theih nan Assam Rifles chuan hma a la a, he hun hi Sawrkar laipuia Minister of State for Minority Affairs Pu John Barla chuan a hmanpui dawn a, hna hmu tharte kutah appointment letter a hlan dawn a ni. Ram chhung hmun hrang hranga hun hmante hi Prime Minister chuan Video Conferencing kaltlangin a chhim dawn a ni. Rozgar Mela hi Sawrkar laipuiin hna neilote tana hna a siam sakna kawnga hmalakna ngaih pawimawh tak a ni.
hypothesis: ASSAM RIFLES BATTALION-IN MIZORAM STATE TAN 8-NA ROZGAR MELA A BUATSIAK DAWN
raw_text:
ASSAM RIFLES BATTALION-IN MIZORAM STATE TAN 8-NA ROZGAR MELA A BUATSIAK DAWN

195/2023-2024

Aizawl, 26 August, 2023 - Headquarters Inspector General Assam Rifles (East) hnuaia Battalion chuan 28 August 2023-ah 2 AR Gajraj Hall, Lakhimpur Battalion-ah 8-na Rozgar Mela a buatsaih dawn a ni. He Mela hian mi tam tak a hlawkpui dawn a ni.

Central Government chuan 28 August 2023-ah 8-na Job Fair a buatsaih dawn a ni. He thilthleng hi state 25 aia tam leh hmun 44 aia tamah a kal chhuak ang a, India Sawrkar Department hrang hrang atanga tlangval leh naupang kumthar mi 70,000 vel hnenah appointment letter sem a ni dawn a ni.

Kan Prime Minister zahawm tak Narendra Modi chuan he programme hi a kaihruai ang a, live streaming hmangin tlangvalte a thusawi dawn a ni. Chu zawhah chuan candidate lo kalte hnenah appointment letter sem a ni ang.

Assam Rifles chuan Mizoram state tana Rozgar Mela buatsaih leh programme inzawmkhawmna enkawl kawngah pawimawh takin hna a thawk mek a ni. Minority Affairs Minister zahawm tak, Pu John Barla chuan candidate-te hnenah appointment letter chu amah ngeiin a hlan dawn a ni. Prime Minister zahawm tak chuan Video Conferencing hmangin inkhawmna chu a en ang.

Rozgar Mela hi sawrkarin hnathawhna siam belh hi a ngaih pawimawh ber a ni tih tihhlawhtlinna lam panin hmalakna pakhat a ni.

source:
A. As the Indwelling Spirit
God puts His Spirit in us so that His Spirit may be the indwellingSpiritwithinus,thatwemayknowGodandexpe- rience all that God in Christ has accomplished for us (Rom. 8:9-11). This is the special blessing given by God in the New Testament era; it did not exist in the Old Testament. In the OldTestament,GodonlycausedHisSpirittocomefromwith- out to work upon man; He did not cause His Spirit to dwell withinman. Only after the Lord’s death and resurrection did God give His Spirit to us and cause His Spirit to dwell in us as the indwelling Spirit (John 14:16-17). Thus, He is able to reveal both God and Christ to us from within,that we in Christ may receive and enjoy the fullness of God (Col. 2:9-10).
reference:
A. Chhûnglama Chenchilhtu Thlarau Angin
Pathianin kan chhûngah a thlarau a dah a, tichuan a thlarau chu kan chhûngah chenchilhtu Thlarau a ni ang a, Pathian hriatna leh Pathian lama Krista-in kan tâna a hlenchhuah zawng zawng tawnhriatna kan nei thei dawn a ni (Rom 8:9-11). Hei hi Thuthlung Thar huna malsawmna danglam bik Pathianin a pêk chu a ni a; Thuthlung Hluiah a awm rêng rêng lo a ni. Thuthlung Hluiah chuan Pathian chuan a Thlarau chu pawnlama mihring chunga hnathawk tur ringawtin a siam a, mihring chhûngah chuan a Thlarau chu chenchilh turin a siam lo a ni. Lalpa thihna leh thawhlehna hnuah chauh chuan Pathian chuan a Thlarau chu kan hnenah min pe in, chenchilhtu Thlarau angin Thlarau chu kan chhûnga nung turin a siam a (John. 14:16-17). Hei vâng hian kan chhûnglam aṭangin Pathian leh Krista chu a puangchhuak thei a, tichuan Pathian khahna chu keini Krista ami ten kan lo dawn a kan chen theihna turin a ni (Kol. 2:9-10).
hypothesis: A. Chhunga Chêng Thlarau anga
raw_text:
A. Chhunga Chêng Thlarau anga

Pathianin A Thlarau chu kanah a dah a, chu a Thlarau chu kan chhunga chêng Thlarau a nih theih nân, Pathian kan hriat theih nân leh Krista-ah Pathianin kan tâna a tih zawng zawng kan hriatthiam a, kan chan ve theih nân a ni (Rom. 8:9-11). Hei hi Thuthlung Thar hunah Pathianin malsâwmna bik a pêk a ni; Thuthlung Hlui hunah chuan a awm lo. Thuthlung Hlui-ah chuan, Pathianin A Thlarau chu pâwn lam ata mihring chungah thawktîr mai a ni a; A Thlarau chu mihring chhûngah chêngtîr lo. Lalpa thihna leh thawhlehna hnuah chauh Pathianin A Thlarau chu kan pê a, kan chhûngah chêng Thlarau anga chêngtîr a ni (Johana 14:16-17). Chutiang chuan, Amah chuan Pathian leh Krista chu kan chhûng lam ata min hrilhfiah thei a, chutichuan Krista-ah Pathian famkimna zawng zawng chu kan dawng a, kan lo chang thei ta a ni (Kol. 2:9-10).

An card an hman dik chuan chutiang hmunte chu an thlen theih ngei a ni tih pawh a sawi bawk. Sportsperson-te tana state sorkar leh central sorkar hnuaia scheme leh hamthatna awmte zir chiang turin pawh a fuih bawk.

source: Floral tributes paid to Mahatma Gandhi in Mizoram No.244/2020-2021 Aizawl the 2nd October, 2020: Floral tributes were paid at the statue of Mahatma Gandhi early this morning at MG Road, Aizawl by the Hon'ble Governor, Chief Minister Deputy Chief Minister and other leaders of the state on the 151st birth anniversary of the Father of the Nation. Governor P.S. Sreedharan Pillai, Chief Minister Zoramthanga, Deputy Chief Minister Tawnluia offered floral wreath on the occasion. Legislative Assembly Speaker and Dy Speaker, Ministers and MLAs, AMC Mayor and important officials also placed floral offering. Celebrated yearly across the country on October 2nd, Gandhi Jayanti is one of the official declared national holidays of India, observed in all of its states and territories. source: CHIEF MINISTER ATTENDED GRADUATION AND LAMP LIGHTING CEREMONY AT RIPANS Chief Minister Pu Zoramthanga attended the Lamp Lighting & Graduation Ceremony at Regional Institute of Paramedical and Nursing Sciences(RIPANS), Aizawl as chief guest yesterday. Speaking on the occassion, the Chief Minister offered his congratulations to the graduates, wishing them success in their future careers. He also encouraged the new B.Sc Nursing students to be diligent in their studies to become exceptional healthcare professionals, which is one of the most noble profession. Speaking of how the government takes various measures to ensure examplary healthcare system, the Chief Minister said that public support is needed for success. In yesterday's function the Chief Minister gave away Proficiency Award to toppers of all departments in the institute. This year saw 180 graduates from RIPANS with 36 B.Sc. Nursing, 40 B.Sc. MLT (Medical Laboratory Technology), 23 B. Pharm, 34 B. Optometry, 31 B.Sc. RIT (Radio Imaging Technology) and 16 M. Pharm. Dr. Chawngthanliana, Director, RIPANS handed out Certificate of Appreciation to the new Graduates and Post Graduates. 35 students of B.Sc Nuring were newly inducted through the Lamp Lighting Ceremony with Pi Lalrinthangi, Nursing Superintendent, Civil Hospital Aizawl as lamp lighter. RIPANS was set up by the Ministry of Home Affairs in 1995-96 under North Eastern Council (NEC). Then it was transferred to the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare on April, 2007. As of 2019, 2820 students have graduated from RIPANS since it's inception in 1996. Presently, there are 655 students enrolled in the six departments the institution offers. With the recommendation of the Meeting of Executive Council of the Institute under the Ministry earlier this year which approved Rs. 480.12 cr. for Upgradation and Development of RIPANS, plans to open seven more departments. Apart from this, creation of 154 posts including that of medical doctors, nurses and other paramedics, and infrastructural developments including hospitals, academic building, sports complex, hostel and quarters are underway. Chief Minister chuan Mizoramah mihring hriselna tihhmasawn a inenkawlna tha zawk neih chu sawrkarin a ngaihpawimawh thu a sawi a. Chumi atan chuan sawrkar chauhin thil a tih theihloh thu leh, hriselna kawnga ramin hma a sawn tak tak dawn chuan mipui tawiawmna a mamawh thu a sawi. Chief Minister chuan RIPANS pawh changtlung zawka siam tura hmalakna awm mek chu lawmawm a tih thu sawiin, thawktu indaihlohna avanga harsatna an tawh chungchangah theih tawp chhuahpui a tum thu a sawi a ni. Chief Minister chuan graduate thar te zingah an department theuh a titha zualte hnenah RIPANS Proficiency Award a hlan bawk. Vawiin hunah hian RIPANS Director Dr. Chawngthanliana leh Lamp Lighter Civil Hospital Nursing Superintendent Pi Lalrinthangi ten thu an sawi bawk. BSc Nursing First year hi an vawiin mi 35 an ni a. RIPANS Director Dr. Chawngthanliana chuan Graduate leh Post Graduate tharte hnenah Certificate of Appreciation a hlan a ni. Kumin hian a vaiin mi 180 zirchhuak an awm a. Chungte chu: i) B.Sc. Nursing - 36 ii) B.Sc. MLT (Medical Laboratory Technology) - 40 iii) B. Pharm - 23 iv) B. Optometry - 34 v) B.Sc. RIT (Radio Imaging Technology) - 31 vi) M. Pharm - 16 RIPANS hi kum 1996 khan North Eastern Council (NEC) in India hmarchhak mite tan Paramedical leh Health Sciences bik zirna atana din in, kum 2007 April thla atangin sawrkar laipuia Ministry of Health and Family Welfare hnuaiah dah a ni ta a. Tun dinhmunah Degree Course hrang hrang panga - B.Sc Nursing, B.Sc Medical laboratory Technology, B. Pharm, B. Optometry leh B.Sc Radio Imaging Technology bakah October 2014 atang khan Post Graduate Course M. Pharm te awmin, India hmarchhak state hrang hrang atangin zirlaite tan seat hauhsa (quota) neiih zirlai 655 an awm mek a ni. Kum 1996 atanga kumin 2019 thleng hian RIPANS atanga zirchhuak mi 2820 an awm tawh a ni. Ministry of Health & Family Welfare hnuaia Executive Council meeting kumin kumtir a neihin RIPANS tihchangtlun na turin Rs. 480.12 crores pek a remti a. He hmalakna hnuaiah hian khum 100 awm theihna hospital, Academic building, Indoor Sports Complex cum Auditorium, P.G. Hostel, Guest House, Medical Superintendent Quarter, Doctor Quarter, Nurses/ Staff quarter sakna tur te, thawktu post 154 siam belhna tur leh Course thar pasarih hawnna tur te a tel a ni. source: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visits Champhai Tlangsam Winery 326/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 1st February 2023 : Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati, who is on a two-day tour of Champhai District visited the Tlangsam Winery on the outskirt of Champhai Town this evening. At the site, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati was given an escorted tour to various units by the managing officers of the winery. Thereafter, a short program was held at B Remmawia Packing hall, Champhai Winery. Governor Hari Babu expressed his delight in visiting the factory started, owned, and managed by a society of farmers. He was particularly appreciative of having witness the production centre where the determined farmers themselves added value to their products. He congratulated the Champhai Grape Growers Society and the Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Ltd. Governor welcomed the ambitious proposal to upgrade these wineries at Champhai and Hnahlan to accomodate the growing production of the Grapes in these areas. He extended his support for this proposal and if necessary, he agreed to discuss the matter with the authorities in the Ministry of Food Processing Industries(MoFPI). On behalf of Champhai Winery, Pu Hrilchunglura, General Manager, Champhai Grape Growers Society(GGGS) gave a report. The Winery was started in 2007. After 14 years of existence with the production actually started in 2010 the Winery has now grown. At present the society has 134 members. The fruit is of Bangalore Blue variety. During last year the Winery bought 1144.98 qts of grapes. As the grape production increases, CGGS submitted two projects - one project to MoFPI and another project to state department under Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK). Governor hi Environment, Forest & Climate Change Minister Pu T.J. Lalnuntluanga, Champhai South bialtu MLA ni bawk bakah DC Champhai Pu James Lalrinchhana, SP Pu Lalrinpuia Varte leh Official dangten an tawiawm a ni. Governor Pu Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Champhai Winery tlawh theia a awm chu lawmawm a tih thu sawiin, an hmalaknate engemawchen a lo hriat tawh thu a sawi a. Champhai District-a Winery pahnih lai a awm leh loneitute intelkhawmin an kalpui chu ropui a tih thu a sawi a. Grape chingtuten harsatna an tawh chu pawi a tih thu sawiin, Sawrkarin dan thar siama hma a la chu lawmawm a ti a. Wine siam chu food processing hnuaia a awm anih thu sawiin, agriculture product-te cheibawla siam danglam value addition chu hmalakna pawimawh tak a ni, a ti a. Tun aia nasaa huang zauh leh changtlung zawka kal tura Ministry of Food Processing Industries kaltlanga hmalakna an nei chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk. Governor chuan Grape chauh nilo thei dang sawr leh um theihte pawh ngaihvena huang zauh a tul thu a sawi a. An hmalak lehzelna turah duhsakna a hlan a, Mizoram mai nilo India rama loneitute tana entawntlak leh tihhmuhtu nih tum turin a chah a ni. Environment, Forest & Climate Change Minister Pu T.J. Lalnuntluanga chuan Champhai District chhunga loneitute hmalakna pawimawh tak grape sawngbawlna hmunhma Governor-in a hun hlu tak senga a tlawh chu lawmawm a ti a. Hun harsa tak paltlanga dan anga grape zawrhna tur dan thar Sawrkarin a siam thu sawiin, grape chingtuten hmabak eng tak an neih thu sawiin duhsakna a hlan a. Tun aia nasa zawka hma la a, ram ngaw humhalh nan kum tina lovah thin bansana lo nghet nei thei tura ngaihtuahna seng turin a chah a. Tun atanga reiloteah Sapthei sawngbawlna turte pawh buaipui tum anih thu sawiin, harsatna an neihte a hnena thlen hrehlo turin a chah a ni. Inkawmhona hun Packing Hall, Champhai Winery, Tlangsama hman hi Pu HS.Vanlalfakzuala, Chairman, Champhai Grape Growers Society (CGGS) chuan a kaihruai a. Pu Hrilchunglura, General Manager hnen atangin report ngaihthlak a ni a. Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Limited hotute atangin thusawi ngaihthlak a ni bawk. Mizoram hi North East India-a grape thar awm chhun leh India rama grape thar tam 5-na niin, Champhai leh Hnahlan-ah Winery a awm a. CGGS enkawl Champhai Winery hian kum 14 hmel a hmu tawh a, an Grape sawngbawl hi Bangalore Blue variety niin, vawiin thlengin Grape quintal ,15,218 an lei tling tawh a, hemi atan hian Rs 5,78,41,160/- (cheng vaibelchhe nga maktaduai sarih nuai riat singli sangkhat za leh sawmruk) an seng tawh a ni. Kum 2010 atang khan Grape quintal 918 leiin bul an tan a, kum kalta khan quintal 1144.98 an lei tling a, an Grape lakte hi herin a umna zemah an um mek a ni. Kum 2007 khan Champhai Grape Growers Association (CGGA) tih thin chu Winery din anih dawn avangin Champhai Grape Growers Society (CGGS) ti a thlak niin, Firms & Society-ah an inziahlut a ni. MIP sum cheng nuai 83 (loan) hmanga bultan niin, he loan hi November ni 9, 2020 khan Sawrkar chuan rulh let ngai lo turin grant-ah a leh sak a ni. Champhai Grape Growers Society-ah hian Governing Board Member 15 awmin kum 2 danah inthlan thin a ni a. Tun dinhmunah hian Champhai Grape Growers Society-ah hian Grape chingtu member 134 awm mekin, Staff leh Worker mi 30, Executive Member 9 leh Office Bearer 6 an awm mek bawk a. Champhai Grape Growers Society hnuaiah hian Branch 9 awm mekin mumal taka inenkawlna kalpui thin a ni. CGGS hian Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MOFPI) kaltlangin project an kalpui mek a. DC Office kaltlangin Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK) hnuaiah Commerce & Industries Department hnuaiah project dil mek a ni bawk a. Dan thar hnuaiah Winery License an nei fel tawh a, State pawn thlenga hralhchhuak thei turin hmachhawp an nei a ni. Champhai Winery a tlawh zawh hian Governor chuan BPL family-te tana a thlawna eirawngbawlna gas connection pekna scheme, Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) kaltlanga hamthatna dawngtu leh khawpuia cheng insak tanpuina scheme, Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Housing for All (Urban) dawngtu Tlangsam ami te a tlawh a; scheme awmzia leh tangkainate a sawifiah a, an hmuh dan leh chhawr tangkai dante a zawt nghal bawk. source: PU LAWMAWMA TOCHHAWNG VICE CHAIRMAN HPC INAUGURATES RENOVATED LUNGLEI POLICE STATION BUILDING 151/2023-2024 Lunglei;the 1st August,2023 : Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Vice Chairman, HPC Lunglei inaugurated a newly renovated Lunglei Police Station Building(Ground Floor) here in Lunglei town, today. Lunglei PS building was constructed wayback in 1991 and the building became dilapidated and worn out.Lunglei PS building is a two storey building. Lunglei High Powered Committee Funded this renovation works, at the tune of Rs.15 lakh for each storey. Rs.15 lakh was released for the year 202-2023 which was being used for renovation of Ground Floor, which was inaugurated today. Fund for 1st Floor renovation is also released for the year 2023-2024 and renovation works will be carried out by Police dept, at their earliest. In his augural speech Pu Lawmawma highlighted that Lunglei PS managed to bag the Best Police Station of India Award during 2022-2023.It is quite befitting that the building is also renovated to become the best PS building in Mizoram. He applauded the renovation works executed by PS staff with their all out efforts and with a spirit of love and ownership to get the best result. He exhorted them, since they could manage to bag the Best PS Award too, to try for the Best in traffic management in the whole India. He implored PS staff to be friendly and polite all the time, so that the public will not have any hesitation and fear in approaching the Police station in their time of troubles and distresses. Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) and Pi Ramdinliani IAS, DC delivered speeches in this function as well. Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) informed the gathering public how HPC had helped police dept. time and again since many past years and said that renovation works was just one amongst many. He entreated and reminded the police dept. to pay back many blessings they had received from various quarters by rendering their best services to the society. Pi Ramdinliani IAS, DC Lunglei heartily congratulated PS staff for their newly renovated building and applauded them for their dedication and hard work put forth in their renovation works and added that it was worth emulating for other depts. Todayâ€™s brief inaugural function was presided over Pu K.Beihmotaosa MPS,Addl.SP Lunglei and Pu Rahool Alwal IPS, SP Lunglei delivered welcome speech,and technical report was given by Pu L.P Zohmangaiha,OC Lunglei PS. PU LAWMAWMA TOCHHAWNG, HPC VICE CHAIRMAN-IN LUNGLEI POLICE STATION BUILDING THAR SIAM ṬHAHNA A HAWNG 151/2023-2024

Lunglei; 1 August, 2023 : Tûn ni hian Lunglei khawpui-ah Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, HPC Lunglei Vice Chairman-in Lunglei Police Station Building thar siam ṭha, Ground Floor chu a hawng.

Lunglei PS building hi kum 1991 khân sak a ni a, hun rei tak a lo kal hnuah building chu a ṭha lo va, a lo ruak chhe ta a ni. Lunglei PS building hi storey hnih nei a ni. He building siam ṭhatna hna hi Lunglei High Powered Committee-in a sum a pe a, storey tin atan Rs.15 lakh zelin a tum a ni. Kum 2022-2023 atan Rs.15 lakh chu release tawh a ni a, chu sum chu Ground Floor siam ṭhatna atan hman a ni a, tûn ni hian chu chu hawng a ni. 1st Floor siam ṭhatna atan pawh kum 2023-2024 atan sum release tawh a ni a, Police department-in a hman nghal turin hna an kalpui dawn a ni.

A hawngna thu sawi-ah Pu Lawmawma chuan kum 2022-2023 chhûng khân Lunglei PS-in India ram pum huapah Best Police Station of India Award an dawng theih thu a sawi. Chutiang taka an hlawhtlin avang chuan building pawh Mizoram-a Police Station building ṭha ber ni thei tura siam ṭhat a nih hi a inhmeh hle tih a sawi bawk. PS staff-te’n an theih tâwp chhuahna leh hmangaihna leh neihna rilru nen hna an thawh avanga siam ṭhatna hna ṭha tak an tih chu a fak hle. Best PS Award an dawng thei tawh ang bawkin, India ram pum huapah traffic management lamah pawh a ṭha ber nih tum tura an bei zui zel turin a fuih bawk. Mipuite’n harsat

source: SIAHA DC CONDUCTS SURPRISED VISITS TO SOME OFFICES Deputy Commissioner, Siaha District, Pu Bhupesh Chaudhary IAS, conducted a surprised visit to some of the Offices, here at Siaha, today. Pu Bhupesh said that he conducted a surprised visits not to find faults, but to know better the set-up and working-nature of each and every office under his jurisdiction, to listen to them and aware of their problems, and most of all;to remind them of the staff that dereliction of duties will be viewed seriously and DC will keep vigil over them all the time. Some of the offices visited, today were Industrial Training Institute, Excise &Narcotics Office, Mizofed, Printing & Stationery Depot, FCS&Consumer Affairs' Godown. Surprised visits will be conducted randomly to all the offices and institutions under GoM , at Siaha District. In his surprised visits,DC was accompanied by Pu Amol Srivastava IAS, Asst.Commissioner, Pu H.Zonunmawia, Election Officer and Pu N.Vabeiratlua,DIPRO. Attachment Loading attachment...

SIAHA DC-IN OFFICE THENKHATTE A HMUH THLENG RUK A NEIH

Siaha District Deputy Commissioner, Pu Bhupesh Chaudhary IAS chuan tun hian Siaha khuaah office thenkhatte a hmuh thleng ruk a nei a. Pu Bhupesh chuan he hmuh thleng ruk hi thil dik lo zawng tur a ni lo va, ama thuneihna hnuaia office tinte dinhmun leh an thawh dan chiang zawka hriat theih nan, an thu ngaihthlak a, an harsatna hre chiang turin leh a pawimawh berah chuan staff-te hriattirna atan, an mawhphurhna an tihhlawhtlin loh chuan ngaih pawimawh takin a awm dawn a, DC chuan hun tinrengah an chungah vilna a nei reng dawn tih hriattir nan a ni, a ti.

Tunah hian a tlawh office thenkhatte chu Industrial Training Institute, Excise & Narcotics Office, Mizofed, Printing & Stationery Depot, FCS & Consumer Affairs Godown te an ni. GoM hnuaia Siaha District-a office leh institution zawng zawngteah hian hmuh thleng ruk hi random takin neih zel a ni dawn.

A hmuh thleng ruk neihnaah hian DC hi Pu Amol Srivastava IAS, Asst. Commissioner, Pu H. Zonunmawia, Election Officer leh Pu N. Vabeiratlua, DIPRO ten an tawiawm a ni.

source: Mizoram Governor felicitates the first-rank holders of MBSE Class 10 & 12 Examination 71/2024-2025 Aizawl, the 27th May, 2024: Governor Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati felicitated the first-rank holders of the High School Leaving Certificate and Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examination 2024 at the Raj Bhavan, today. The topper from HSLC and three toppers from arts, commerce and science stream of HSSLC received Cash Incentives and Citations from the Governor. G overnor Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati had an interactive session with each student and asked them about their career plans. He congratulated and conveyed his best wishes to the students and encouraged them to continue performing to the best of their abilities to secure greater success for their future career and endeavours. As per the results of the HSLC Exam and HSSLC Exam 2024 published by the Mizoram Board of School Education (MBSE) recently, Lalmoipuia Lawmzual s/o H.L. Lawmzuala, St. Paul's Higher Secondary School, Aizawl secured the First Rank in the High School Leaving Certificate Examination, 2024. Lalramdina Ralte s/o Lalthakima, St. Paul's Higher Secondary School, Aizawl is the topper in Science stream. David Lalhminghlua s/o Paul Zakhuma, St. Paul's Higher Secondary School, Aizawl is the topper in Commerce stream and Linden Lalremruatpuia s/o C. Lalrindika, Oikos Higher Secondary School, Aizawl is the topper in Arts stream, in the results of the Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examinations, 2024. Attachment Loading attachment...

raw_text:
Mizoram Governor-in MBSE Class 10 leh 12 Examination 71/2024-2025-a rank pakhatna neitute a lawmna a pe

Aizawl, May ni 27, 2024: Governor Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan tun hian Raj Bhavan-ah High School Leaving Certificate leh Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examination 2024-a rank pakhatna neitute chu lawmna a pe a. HSLC topper leh HSSLC-a arts, commerce leh science stream-a topper pathumte chu Governor kut atangin Cash Incentives leh Citation an dawng a ni.

Governor Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan zirlaite pakhat tin nen inkawmhona hun a hmang a, an hmalakna leh an hna hmachhawn tur chungchang a zawt a. Ani chuan zirlaite chu lawmthu a sawi a, hmalam hunah an hna leh an tumteah hlawhtlinna nasa zawk an neih theih nan an thiamna ang zela tha takin an kal zel turin fuihna a pe bawk.

source: DISTRICT TASK FORCE COMMITTEE HELD EMERGENCY MEETING ON COVID-19 AT SIAHA District Task Force,Siaha mulled over how to take preventive measures against Covid-19 pandemic in the emergency meeting held, here at Siaha. District Magistrate had already issued prohibitory order on last Friday(7/3/2020), the order prohibited Cross- border movement between Myanmar and India through passages/roads that linked Myanmar and 10 villages within Siaha district namely: : Lopu, Chapi, Khaikhy, Zyhno,Lodaw, Lomasu, Iana, Siasi, Laki and Khopai village. The Same order highlighted that Check points will be set up at 3 villages namely: Kaochao, Tlapi and Tipi Ferry which located at Inter District Border. In pursuant to the said prohibitory Order, Siaha BDO and Tipa BDO have left for those 10 villages to call for GramSabha meeting and to sensitize about Covid-19 and Prohibitory Order. Today's meeting resolved that villagers of those 10 villages be requested to form a joint committee comprising of Church, NGOs and Village council to vigil over border passage/road that linked their respective village and Myanmar.The meeting also resolved that MADC Forest Guard and India Army stationed at villages located India-Myanmar Border be requested to help proposed village's Joint committee in their vigilant works on Border road/passage. Today's meeting also decided that on the 13th&14th March,2020 a Team comprising Medical officials, Leaders of NGOs, Joint VC members, Police personnel and DC office staff will visited those 13 villages and witness preventive measures taken by each village and carry out sensitization campaign as well. CMO & DMS informed the meeting that there was only one Thermal Infra Red Sensor and 15 Personal Protection Equipments (PPE) presently at Siaha; and 2 TIRS will arrive shortly. TIRS and Self Reporting Format will be placed at check points; and by using TIRS leh Self reporting format; suspected Covid-19 infected travellers will be identified and quarantine for 20 days. Tarik ni 7/3/2020 ah khan District Magistrate chuan Siaha district a khaw 10: Lopu, Chapi, Khaikhy, Zyhno,Lodaw, Lomasu, Iana, Siasi, Laki leh khopai khua te leh Myanmar inkalpawhna kawng a lo khar tawh a. He mi bakah hian Inter district Border crossing point a khaw 3: Kaochao,Tipi Ferry leh Tlapi-ah te Check post siamna tur order a lo chhuah tawh a ni. Heng khaw 13-ah te hian Gram Sabha ko-a Sentisization campaign neih turin Siaha BDO leh Tipa BDO te pawh vawiin lamah an feh chhuak tawh bawk a ni. Vawiin meeting chuan heng khaw 13 -ah te hian Kohhran,NGO leh VC te joint Committee din theuh tura ngen relin, heng Joint Committee te hian an khua nena Myanmar inkalpawhna kawng/khan te chu vil theuh tura ngen a rel bawk. An mahni puibawm turin MADC Forest dept leh Border Area khuaa India sipai awmte pawh sawm an rel bawk. Heng khaw 13-ah te hi tarik ni 13 leh 14 March,2020 khian Medical, NGO hruaitute, Joint VC hruaitute, Police leh DC office joint team te chuan tlawhin, Covid-19 laka inven nana heng khaw 13 ten Myanmar nena inkalpawhna kawng an vil dan te enpuiin, Sentisization campaign an neih zui nghal dawn a ni. Tunah hian Siaha Medical office te chuan khawsik hriat theina khawl Thermal Infra Red Sensor pakhat leh Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) 15 chauh an nei a, TIRS hi 2 a lo kal mek thu report a ni a. Heng TIRS te hi Check post pathumah an dah dawn a ni. TIRS bakah hian medical dept chuan Self Reporting Format hi check point 3 ah an dah vek ang. raw_text:
Siaha-ah COVID-19 chungchanga hmanhmawh khawmpui District Task Force Committee-in an nei

Siaha District Task Force chuan Siaha-ah hmanhmawh khawmpui an neihnaah Covid-19 hripui laka venhimna kalpui dan tur an ngaihtuah a. District Magistrate chuan kal ta ni zingah, Friday (7/3/2020)-ah khap thupek a lo chhuah tawh a; chu thupek chuan Myanmar leh India inkara ramri kal tlangna kawngte, Siaha district chhunga khua 10 Myanmar nena inzawmte, hengte hi a khap a ni: Lopu, Chapi, Khaikhy, Zyhno, Lodaw, Lomasu, Iana, Siasi, Laki leh Khopai. Chu thupek vek chuan Inter District Border-a awm khua pathum, Kaochao, Tlapi leh Tipi Ferry-ah check point siam tur a ni tih a sawi bawk.

Chu khap thupek zawmna atan Siaha BDO leh Tipa BDO-te chu khua 10-ah chuan Gram Sabha meeting koh turin leh Covid-19 leh khap thupek chungchang hrilhfiahna pe turin an kal ta a ni. Tuni khawmpui chuan khua 10 mite chu an khua leh Myanmar inzawmna ramri kawngte venhim turin Kohhran, NGO leh Village Council aiawhte telna Joint Committee siam turin ngen an ni ang tih a rel a. Khawmpui chuan India-Myanmar ramri khua-a awm MADC Forest Guard leh India Army-te pawh chu khua Joint Committee siam turte hna an thawhnaah puih turin ngen an ni ang tih a rel bawk.

Tuni khawmpui chuan March ni 13 leh 14, 2020-ah Medical official-te, NGO hruaitute, Joint VC member-te, Police personnel-te leh DC office staff-te telna team pakhatin khua 13-te chu tlawh ang a, khua tinte’n venhimna an kalpui dan hmuhpuiin hrilhfiahna campaign pawh an kalpui ang tih a rel bawk. source: What then is the way to possess the good land? It is not so simple. Let us enumerate and review the steps. First of all, we must enjoy Christ as the redeeming lamb. We must receive Christ as our Savior. We must pass the judgment of God. This is the first step. If we have done this, we can put a check here; the first item has been passed. What is the second step? We must leave Egypt and enjoy Christ as our daily manna, as our daily life-supply. Of course, we cannot take food without drinking water; so at the same time we must enjoy Christ as the rock with the living water flowing forth. We enjoy the manna and we enjoy the rock with the living water. Do you have such an experience day by day? Many of you can boldly say that you do. Every day you enjoy Christ as your food and as your drink. Otherwise, you could not live, you could not go on, you could not maintain your life as a Christian. Day by day, we must enjoy Christ as our daily food and our living water; we must have something to eat and something to drink. Whenever we meet in the morning, instead of greeting one another with “Good morning!” let us ask “Have you eaten?” I do prefer such a greeting. Have you eaten this morning, brother? Have you drunk something this morning, sister? Some of you can answer that you have had three good meals today. Praise the Lord! We must tell people that day by day we are feeding on Christ. We are eating Christ and we are drinking Christ. If we have this experience, we can check this also.

source: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT CONSULTATIVE COMMITTEE (DCC) & DISTRICT LEVEL REVIEW COMMITTEE (DLRC) No.517/2020-2021 Champhai District Consultative Committee (DCC) & District Level Review Committee (DLRC) under the Chairmanship of Pi Maria C.T. Zuali, Deputy Commissioner Champhai held meeting today at DCâ€™s Conference Hall, the Chairman launched the Potential Credit Linked Plan (PLP) 2021-2022 for Champhai District. Chairman urged the Bankers to conduct massive and wider public awareness campaign on facilities provided through Banks. Also the Deputy Commissioner reiterated the urgency of making application forms more simplified instead of intricated forms to facilitate ease of doing business. Pu L.Lawmvela, Lead District Manager (LDM), SBI Lead Bank Office delivered welcome speech followed by discussion on the performances of Bankers and Stakeholders for the quarter ended September, 2020. According to the reporting period, Credit-Deposit (CD) ratio was 44.71 %, against the norm of 60%. Achievement under Priority Sector was 38.42 % while it was 73.43% under Non Priority Sector. Under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) there were 34 beneficiaries (Sishu-20, Kishore-98, Tarun-12, Stand Up India-4) getting loan amounting rupess 200.49 lakhs. Target achievement under Government Sponsored Schemes were also discussed at length. Forty two Bakijai Cases amounting rupees 21.61 lakhs have been reported, and no recovery is reported during the quarter. Non Performing Asset (NPA) under Priority Sector was rupees 1217.20 lakhs (7.07%) while the same in Non Priority Sector was rupees 86.40 lakhs (2.25%). Annual Credit Plan Target for Financial Year 2021-2022 and PMEGP Annual Credit Plan Target were also discussed and approved at the meeting. Also Social Security Schemes, Currency remittance, Bank security, Calendar for DCC meeting and timely submission of DCC data were also discussed among other issues. As of now, there are 15 different Banks branches operating in the district; 4 Public Sector Banks, 4 Private Sector Banks, 6 Regional Rural Banks and 1 State Cooperative Bank. There are a total of 9 ATMs, 8 Business Correspondents, 1 CSP, 26 IPPB Banking Touch Points and 2 Financial Literacy Centres (Lead Bank Office, SBI Sponsored and Champhai Financial Literacy Centre, MCAB Ltd.) in the district.
