source: Then what will be the ultimate issue? Simply this—on the one hand, there will be the New Jerusalem, and on the other, the lake of fire. The New Jerusalem is the Triune God mingled together with the resurrected man, and the lake of fire is Satan’s ultimate destruction. The lake of fire is the place for Satan. All that is not related to the Triune God and the resurrected man will be put into the lake of fire with Satan. There will be only one tree in the New Jerusalem—the tree of life. The other tree will be in the lake of fire. This is the ultimate conclusion of the whole Scripture. The Scriptures began with three parties, but the ultimate consummation will be the New Jerusalem with only the first tree at the center of the city and the resurrected man as the expression of the Triune God. The second tree will be cast into the lake of fire. All things and all people related to the second tree will have the same destiny as Satan—in that lake of fire.

source: The fellowship of life and the sense of life are mutually related. As soon as the fellowship of life is interrupted, the sense of life causes us to feel we have lost the supply of life. source: Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman calls on Chief Minister No.252/2021-2022 Aizawl the 18th August, 2021: Chief Minister Pu Zoramthanga, Chairman of State Planning Board was called on by State Planning Board Chairman Pu Lambor Malngiang (MLA/MDC), Meghalaya today at the formerâ€™s office where they discussed important issues relating to economic development for both states. The Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman expressed his gratitude for the outstanding hospitality shown by Mizoram and hoped that the bond between the two states would continue to flourish. Speaking of how he works closely with Mizo community and many sub-tribes of Mizoram in his constituency, he expressed his optimism for an enduring friendship and partnership in all sectors. Mizoram Chief Minister echoed the importance of nurturing good relations between the two states, and said that should any situation arise where Mizoram can assist Meghalaya in the development of its economy, Mizoram shall do its best. After his meeting with the Chief Minister, Pu Lambor Malngiang met with Mizoram Planning Board Vice Chairman Pu H. Rammawi followed by a meeting with NGO leaders of the state. raw_text:
Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman-in Chief Minister a kawm

No.252/2021-2022  
Aizawl, 18th August, 2021:

Tunah hian Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman Pu Lambor Malngiang (MLA/MDC) chuan Chief Minister leh State Planning Board Chairman Pu Zoramthanga chu a office-ah a kawm a, an pahnih hian ram pahnihte sum leh paih lam hmasawnna chungchang pawimawh tak tak an sawi ho.

Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman chuan Mizoram-in a lo dawnsawnna tha tak avangin lawmthu a sawi a, ram pahnih inkara inzawmna chu hma lamah pawh a lo chak zual zel ang tih a beisei thu a sawi bawk. A constituency-ah Mizo hnam leh Mizoram-a sub-tribe hrang hrangte nena hnaih takin a thawh ho thin thu sawiin, sector zawng zawngah kumkhua rei tak chhung thianṭhatna leh ṭanpuina inzawmna a awm thei ang tih beiseina a lantir.

Mizoram Chief Minister pawhin ram pahnih inkara inlaichinna tha vawn nun zel a pawimawhzia a sawi a, Meghalaya sum leh paih lam hmasawnna atan Mizoram-in a ṭanpui theihna tur eng emaw awm se, Mizoram chuan a theih ang angin a ṭanpui dawn tih a sawi.

Chief Minister a kawm zawhah Pu Lambor Malngiang chuan Mizoram Planning Board Vice Chairman Pu H. Rammawi a kawm leh a, chutah hnuah state-a NGO hruaitute pawh a kawm bawk.

Amah hi Dr. Krishna Chauhan, Expert Member (Economist), Meghalaya State Planning Board leh Pu Enrich GL Nongbri, Law Department, Govt. of Meghalaya ten an ṭawiawm a ni.

source:
THE PRIESTHOOD WITH THE URIM
AND THE THUMMIM
The second governing principle is the priesthood under
the anointing with the urim and the thummim. What is the
priesthood? This is a wonderful and glorious matter. The
priesthood includes fellowship with the Lord and life and
service in His presence. The priesthood is a group of people
who are inconstant fellowship with the Lord. They continu-
ally commune with the Lord and serve in His presence.
They live, walk, and do everything in this way. When
we have fellowship with the Lord, when we commune with
the Lord day by day and moment by moment, and when in
this living fellowship we live, we serve, and we act, we are a
priesthood.

source: Governor Hari Babu and ITCA member discuss opportunities for students to learn space technology 102/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 28th June 2022: Dr SK Prasad, founder member and advisory council member, Indian Technology Congress Association ( ITCA) had called on Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati at the Raj Bhavan this forenoon. In this meeting, he and Governor discussed the opportunities for the students of higher secondary school, college and university in Mizoram to learn space technology. As proposed by his eminent guest, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati welcomed the idea of selecting students with a scientific temper to have a preliminary introduction to space science with the option to continue the advanced study depending on their performance in studies. In this regard, he advised Dr SK Prasad and the institutions he represented to have close coordination with the authorities of Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, Science & Technology Department and Science Teachers Association Of Mizoram. Dr SK Prasad apprised the Governor of their initiatives in teaching the teams of students and assigning them important science projects like making mini satellites and other space technology. He explained the importance given to horning entrepreneurship skills of the students selected in this model of learning. He told Governor that his purpose of visiting is identifying the institutions with whom they will have a series of correspondences to initiate enrollment of the students in the program. reference: Governor Hari Babu leh ITCA hotupa in Mizorama zirlai thiam zual te tana space technology zir theih dan sawi dun 1070/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 28th June 2022: Vawiin chawhma khan Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati leh Dr SK Prasad, founder member and advisory council member, Indian Technology Congress Association ( ITCA), Bangalore te chu Raj Bhavan-ah an inkawm a. He hunah hian Mizorama zirlai thiam filawr te zinga space technology zir duh thlan chhuah dan tur leh an zir theih dan tur te an sawi dun a ni. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Mizorama zirlaite chu lehkha thiam thei tak leh hmundanga zirlaite el phaka thluak tha an ni tih a sawi a. Space technology pawh a zirna kawng a inhawn phawt chuan hlawhtling takin an zir thei turah angai tih a sawi a ni. Governor chuan Dr SK Prasad leh a thawhna hmuna thuneituten Mizoramah zirlai te tan Space Technology zir theihna hun remchang an rawn zawn sak chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi a. Hemi kawngah hian ITCA hotute chuan Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, Science & Technology Department leh Science Teachers Association Of Mizoram berawn se. Anni nena indawrna kaltlang hian zirlai thiam thei zual zinga space technology zir duhte thlanchhuah a awlsam a rin thu a sawi a ni. Dr SK Prasad chuan Prime Minister hmathlir angin India thalaite chu space technology lamah thiamna sang zawk nei tur leh India ram chu a hmahruaitu a nih theih nan chher hriam mek an ni a ti a. He hmalakna kal zelah hian zirlai team 75 te chu kumina project 75 thawk zo hman turin Students' Satellites 75 project hnuaiah satellite te chi(mini satellite) siam turin thlan an ni dawn an a ti. He project-ah hian India rama zirlaite zawng zawng an inel dawn a team 75 thlan an ni dawn a ti a. He project-ah hian Mizorama zirlaite tan pawh tel theihna hun a inhawng thei dawn niin a sawi a ni. Dr Prasad chuan a lo kal chhan tak chu Higher Secondary atanga University Degree zirlaite tan Space Technology zirna an kalpui mek chu Mizorama zirlaite rawn hmelhriat tir a ni a ti a. Hemi kawngah hian Governor leh state sawrkar hotute thlawpna a rawn ngen bakah a bikin science lam zirna kaihhnawiha hotute thawhpuiah a rawn sawm tih a sawi bawk a ni. raw_text:
Governor Hari Babu leh ITCA member-in zirlaite tana space technology zir theihna remchang chungchang an sawi ho 102/2022-2023

Aizawl, 28 June 2022: Indian Technology Congress Association (ITCA) founder member leh advisory council member, Dr SK Prasad chuan tun zing hian Raj Bhavan-ah Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati a hmuak a. He inkhawmnaah hian amah leh Governor chuan Mizoram-a higher secondary school, college leh university zirlaite tana space technology zir theihna remchangte an sawi ho a ni.

A zahawm tak a lo kalin a rawt angin, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan science lama rilru nei zirlaite thlan chhuah a, space science chungchang hriatna hmasa pek an nih theihna leh an zirna thiamna a zirin advanced study zui zel theihna remchang siam chu a lawm hle a ni.

He chungchangah hian, Dr SK Prasad leh a aiawhte institution-te chu Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, Science & Technology Department leh Science Teachers Association of Mizoram hotute nen inzawmna hnaih tak nei turin a fuih a ni.

Dr SK Prasad chuan zirlaite team-te zirtirna an kalpui dan leh mini satellite siam leh space technology dangte anga pawimawh science project-te an pek thin dan Governor hnenah a hrilh a. He model-a zirna kalpui danah hian thlan chhuah zirlaite entrepreneurship skill siamthatna pawimawhna pek a nih dan pawh a sawi bawk.

Amah chuan a lo kal chhan chu programme-ah zirlaite enrollment tan hmalakna bul tan theih nan institution-te nen correspondence series neih turte hriat chhuah a nih tih Governor hnenah a sawi a ni.

source: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT TASK FORCE ON CORONA VIRUS OUTBREAK HELD MEETING In pursuance of the decision made by Mizoram State Level Task Force on Mitigation of Corona Virus, Champhai District Task Force on Corona Virus was formed recently and held its first meeting at DC Conference Hall, yesterday. The meeting was presided over by Pu SL Naveen, IAS Deputy Commissioner Champhai. Given its strategic location, Champhai district being located nearby International Border, the meeting mentioned the needs for proper medical screening at Zokhawthar and restriction on movement particularly travellers based on their travelling history. To boost up the preventive measures, the meeting highlighted the importance of fostering better coordination with the neighbouring district administration of Myanmar. The meeting decided to organize awareness campaigns for villages nearby border areas and preparation of isolation ward for quarantine in case any suspect is detected. CMO Office was assigned to prepare budget encompassing all requirements for further submission to the higher authority. At the border Town of Zokhawthar, Government of Mizoram has been monitoring the situation and is conducting Medical Screening since the 4th of February 2020 with proper Self Reporting Form. Champhai District Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak Contact Number is given as 8588009756/9436376607.
reference: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT TASK FORCE ON CORONA VIRUS OUTBREAK THUKHAWM Tunlaia China leh khawvel ram dangte ngaihven hlawh tak Novel Coronavirus (2019-nCoV) natna leng mek laka Champhai District lo him leh invenlawkna tura din, District Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak chu a vawikhatna turin vawiin chawhnu khan Bawrhsap Pu SL Naveen, IAS hovin DC Conference Hall-ah an thukhawm. Meeting-ah hian Champhai District chu International Border-a awm anih avangin Novel Coronavirus leng darh zel tur laka fimkhur angaih thu tarlan niin, meeting chuan ramri kaltlanga veivak leh sumdawng thinte chu he natna len mekna hmun leh a chhehvelte laka fimkhur turin a ngen a. He hunah hian mihring veivak leh ran khuahkhirh anih dante ngaihthlak a ni bawk a. Champhai District ep Myanmar ram District-te nena inbiakpawh leh inzaitawn zela hmalak a tul thu pawh tarlan a ni a. District Task Force on Coronavirus Outbreak chuan ramri depa awm khuate chu tlawhchhuaka mipuite hnena zirtirna zau zawk kalpui nise, ramri kaltlanga lutte hriselna endik pahin chhui zui ngai awmte pawh chhuichian ni se a ti a. Champhai District Hospital-a Isolation Ward ruahman ni se tih bakah mamawh tur ang budget-te pawh a rang lama siama thuneitu sang zawk hnena thlen nise tih a ni. District Level Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak hi Mizoram State Health Minister leh H&FW Department hotute January Ni 30, 2020 a thukhawm in an din tak State Level Task Force on Mitigation of Corona Virus duh dan anga district tina hma lo la tur a din a ni. Champhai District-a Zokhawtharah February Ni 4, 2020 atang khan Medical Screening hi kalpui tan a ni a, khualzinte chinchang zawhfiah leh a tul anga endik hna hi kalpui thin niin, Self Reporting Form mumal tak kalpui tan a ni tawh bawk. raw_text:
CHAMPHAI DISTRICT TASK FORCE ON CORONA VIRUS OUTBREAK-IN INKHAWMPUI AN NEI

Mizoram State Level Task Force on Mitigation of Corona Virus-in a rel angin, Champhai District Task Force on Corona Virus chu tun hnaiah din a ni a, nimin khan DC Conference Hall-ah an inkhawmpui hmasa ber an nei. He inkhawmpui hi Pu SL Naveen, IAS, Deputy Commissioner, Champhai-in a kaihruai.

Champhai district hi ramri pawimawh tak a ni a, International Border hnaih a awm avangin, inkhawmpui chuan Zokhawtharah medical screening tha tak neih a ngaihzia leh mi kal velna, a bik takin khualzinte chu an kalna chanchin/travel history hmangin khapna leh enfiahna neih a ngaihzia a sawi.

Hripui lo luhna ven himna tih chak zual nan, inkhawmpui chuan Myanmar rama district administration thenawmte nen thawhhona tha zawk siam a pawimawhzia a tarlang bawk.

Inkhawmpui chuan ramri bul vela khua awmteah hriatthiamna campaign buatsaih tur leh suspect pakhat eng emaw hmuh chuan quarantine atan isolation ward buatsaih turin a rel.

CMO Office chu mamawh zawng zawng huam budget siam a, a chungnung zawk authority hnena theh luh turin mawhphurhna pek a ni.

Ramri khawpui Zokhawtharah Mizoram Sawrkar chuan dinhmun chu a vil reng a, 4 February 2020 atang khan Self Reporting Form dik tak hmangin Medical Screening a kalpui mek.

Champhai District Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak Contact Number chu 8588009756 / 9436376607 a ni.

As we have listened, there was a Government of India notification on September 
24, 2020, and based on that, all the states followed. But ‘water’ falls under the state list, 
so the state government has the authority. 16 states and 5 UTs currently have a similar
act regarding this, and 11 states are currently discussing this Act. Four states regarded 
it as unnecessary to have this Act, these are Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Sikkim, and 
Tripura. On the other hand, I believe Mizoram urgently requires this Act, but there must 
be a way to control it. Whoever is capable of doing it must not attempt to pump out 
water, as it could disturb the water tables. So, it is good that such acts as these exist. 
Chapter 6, Section 29 (C), talks about penalties for violators.
reference:
Kan ngaihthlak ang khan, September Ni 24, 2020-ah Govt. of India notification 
a awm a, chu mi dungzuiin State tinah buatsaih a ni bawk a. Amaherawhchu, tui hi State 
List a nih angin state tin sorkar chu a thu viau mai a. Tunah hian State 16 leh UT 5-ah 
he Dan hi neih a ni tawh a. Tin, State 11-ah ngaihtuah mek a ni bawk a. State 4 hi chuan 
an ramah he Dan neih hi tul an ti lova, chungte chu - Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, 
Sikkim leh Tripura te an ni. Mizoram-ah erawh chuan a tul ngawih ngawihin ka hria a. 
Amaherawhchu, control a ngai a ni. Tute’n emaw an duh duhna hmunah an pump 
chhuak rikngawt kha chu a him lova, lei hnuaia water table te pawh tibuai thei a ni. 
Chuvangin, hetianga Dan lo awm hi a tha ka ti a. Chapter 6, section 29(C)-ah khan 
hremna Dan a awm a.
hypothesis: Kan ngaihthlak angin, September 24, 2020-ah India Sawrkarin notification a chhuah a, chu chu innghahchhanin state zawng zawngin an zui ta a ni. Mahse, ‘tui’ hi state list hnuaiah a tla a, chuvangin state sawrkarin thuneihna a nei. Tunah hian state 16 leh UT 5-ah he thil chungchangah hian act ang chi a awm mek a, state 11-in he Act hi an sawi ho mek bawk. State pali chuan he Act hi a tul lo tih an ngai a, chungte chu Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Sikkim leh Tripura an ni. A dang lamah chuan, Mizoram-ah hian he Act hi a hman ngutuk a tulin ka ring, mahse a thunun theihna kawng a awm ngei tur a ni. Tu pawh a tih thei apiangin tui chu an pump chhuak mai tur a ni lo, a chhan chu tui awmna hmunte a tihbuai thei vang a ni. Chuvangin, hetiang act-te hi a awm chu a tha a ni. source: MIZORAM POLICE PRESS STATEMENT 67/2023-2024 PUBLIC ADVISORY ON DIGITAL PAYMENT FRAUD With the increasing use of Digital Payment Systems, Mizoram has also witnessed a sharp increase in digital payment frauds. Cyber fraudsters are finding new methods to dupe vulnerable and unsuspecting citizens. Online financial frauds account for more than 75% of all cyber-crimes reported in the State. With an aim to prevent financial losses to the general public through online frauds, Mizoram Police once again appeals to public to take following precautions: 1. Never share your Banking password, OTP (one time password) or Debit/Credit Card details with others. 2. Never scan QR Code, when you are to receive money. It is only required for transferring money to other accounts. 3. Beware of phishing scams trying to steal your Banking or UPI information. Look out for fake emails and websites, that try to collect information and do not click on unknownâ€™unfamiliar links. 4. Always use familiar websites for online shopping rather than shopping by searching products on search engines. Search results can be misleading and may lead to malicious websites. 5. Ignore advertisements/deals, if they claim that you can earn money with little or no work or you can make money on an investment with little or no risk. If an offer seems too good to be true, it is most likely to be a scam. 6. Beware of fake loan apps that provide quick and easy loans. Such illegal apps will seek a variety of information and permissions from applicants, which is then misused to blackmail them later. If using digital loan app, please ensure that it has RBI authorization. 7. Beware of fraudsters, who impersonate as army/police personnel advertising cheap items online. We urge citizens to exercise extreme caution, while conducting financial transactions online. If you are a victim of financial fraud, call Cyber Helpline 1930 or register your complaints on www.cybercrime.gov.in . STEP BY STEP GUIDE ON REGISTRATION OF COMPLAINT AT www.cybercrime.gov.in : 1. Go to the website â€œ www.cybercrime.gov.inâ€ through any mobile or computer browser (Google, Safari, etc.) 2. There will be two red boxes. Select the box titled â€˜File a complaintâ€. 3. Click on the 7 Acceptâ€™ box that comes up. 4. Click on â€˜Report Cyber Crimeâ€™. 5. On the new page that comes up, first click on â€˜Click here for new userâ€™ on the top right and fill up the form. 6. After logging into your account, register your complaint. Select the cybercrime category that pertains to you. 7. If you were duped of money through an online transaction, select â€˜Online Financial Fraudâ€™ 8. Enter details of the bank account from which money was sent. 9. If payment was done through UPI, select the UPI app (BHIM, GPay, Paytm, etc) which you used to send money. 10. Enter the transaction ID of where you sent the money. Note: Transaction IDs are of 12 digits. They can be obtained from your bank statement or your UPI transaction details received through SMS. 11. If your account had been credited without your knowledge, enter the relevant details on â€˜Credit Transaction detailsâ€™. 12. After having entered all details as required, select â€˜Save as draft and Nextâ€™. 13. On the next page, enter details of the fraudster if you are aware. Then click on â€˜Save as draft and Nextâ€™. 14. On the next page, enter the complainant/victimâ€™s details and then click on â€˜Save as draft and Nextâ€™. 15. Lastly, click on â€˜I Agreeâ€™ and then â€˜Confirm and Submitâ€™. After this has been completed, you will receive an SMS with an acknowledgement number through which you will be able to keep track of your case.
reference: MIZORAM POLICE PRESS STATEMENT 566/2023-2024 Mizoram police media cell chuan Digital Payment System chungchanga mipuite hnena thurawn a hnuaia mi ang hian a ti chhuak : DIGITAL PAYMENT INBUMNA CHUNGCHANGA THURAWN : Digital Payment Systems hman kan uar chhoh viau laiin hemi kaihhnawiha inbumna pawh nasa takin Mizoramah ngei pawh a sang chho chak hie a ni. Hetianga internet khawvela bum tur zawng ho hian rinhlelh nachang hre lo leh bum awlsam tur zawngin, inbum dan thar an hmu chhuak reng bawk. Tunah hian Mizorama Cyber Crime case ziah luh zinga 75% aia tarn hi 'online financial fraud' kaihhnawih a ni. Chuvangin hetianga inbumna laka kan himna atan Mizoram Poice chuan a hnuaia tarlan ang hian mipuite a ngen a ni: I banking password, OTP, Debit Card/Credit Card details te tumah hrilh suh. Pawisa dawngtu tur i nihin eng QR Code mah scan suh. Pawisa thawn chhuaktu tur tan lo chuan engmah scan a ngai lo. Phishing scammer te hian i Bank leh UPI information pawimawh ruksak che an turn reng tih hria la, email leh website lemah te, link hriat chian lohah te lut mai mai suh ang che. Online-a thil i lei dawnin Search Engine atanga product zawn hi a him tawk lo thin a, chuvangin online shopping website hriat chian saah ngei thil enin lei thin ang che. Engmah thawk mang lova pawisa hlawh theihna te, pawisa dah punna hlawk lutuk leh him si tih ang chi, thil tha uchuak lutuk ang hi inbumna a ni tlangpui tih hria ang che. Awlsam leh rang taka Loan pe chhuak thei anga insawi application leh website lakah fimkhur ang che. Loan pe turin mimal thil pawimawh tinreng an dil a, heng te hi a hnua blackmail lehna atan te an hmang thin a ni. Loan App i hmang a nih pawhin RBI phalna nei an ni ngei em tih chian ang che. Police/Army anga insawi a, thil tlawm tak taka tiral duh anga online-a inzuar thinte hi misual an ni tlangpui tih hre bawk ang che. Online a sum chet velna tur thil khawih reng rengin theihtawpa fimkhur turin mipuite kan chah nawn leh a, hetianga bumna tuartu i nih chuan Cyber Helpline 1930-ah emaw, www.cybercrime.gov.in ah emaw complaint i thehlut thei a ni. A HNUAIA TARLAN ANG HI www.cybercrime.gov.in AH COMPLAINT THEHLUH DAN A NI. 1. Mobile leh Computer browser (Google, Safari, etc.) eng atang pawhin www.cybercrime.gov.in i lut ang. 2. Box sen pahnih a lo awm ang a, "File Complaint' tih zawkah i lut ang. 3. "I Accept" tih a lo lang ang a, i lo click ang. 4. "Report Cyber Crime" tih i hmu ang a, i click ang. 5. Page thar a lo inhawng ang a, "Click here for new user" tihah lutin, form i fill-up ang. 6. Account i logged-in hnuah cyber crime category thlanna a lo awm ang a, i report duh category i thlang ang. 7. Online transaction hmanga bum i nih chuan "Online Financial Fraud" i thlang ang. 8. Pawisa thawn chhuaktu bank account details i chhu lut ang. 9. UPI hmanga pawisa thawn a nih chuan i UPI App hman (BHIM, Gpay, Paytm, etc.) i thlang ang. 10. I pawisa thawn chhuahna Transaction ID i chhu lut ang. Hriattur: Transaction ID hi digit 12 a ni a, pawisa i thawn a bank atanga SMS i dawn thin angah khan a awm. 11. I account-ah i hriatlohvin pawisa a lo lut a nih chuan "Credit Transaction Details" tihah khan a tul angin i fill up bawk dawn nia. 12. Hetianga a ml i tih zawh hnu hian "Save as Draft and Next" tih i thlang ang. 13. A phek dawt lehah a misual/bumtu i hriat chuan a details i fill up ang a, "Save as Draft and Next" i thlang leh ang. 14. A phek dawt lehah a tuartu/a complaint tu details i fill up ang a, "Save as Draft and Next" i thlang leh ang. 15. "I Agree" i thlang ang a, chumi hnuah "Confirm and Submit" i thlang leh dawn nia. Hetianga i tih zawh hnu hian SMS in acknowledgement number i dawng ang a, chumi hmang chuan i case chinchang i enzui duh hunah i enzui thei ang.

Digital Payment System hman a pung zel avangin, Mizoram-ah pawh digital payment fraud a tam chak hle a ni. Cyber fraud tih thei mi sual takte chuan mipuite, a bik takin anmahni invenghimna nei lo leh hriat loh avanga an awlsam taka bum theihte bum nan kawng thar thar an hmuh chhuak zel a ni. Online financial fraud te hi State chhunga cyber-crime report zawng zawng zinga 75% aia tam an ni.

Online fraud avanga mipuite sum chan theihna veng turin, Mizoram Police chuan mipuite hi a hnuaia fimkhur ngaihna te hi lo zawm turin a ngen leh ta a ni:

1. I Banking password, OTP (one time password) emaw Debit/Credit Card details emaw mi dang hnenah engtik lai pawhin sem suh.
2. Sum i dawn turin QR Code scan ngai a ni lo. QR Code hi sum account dangah transfer nan chauh a ngai.
3. Phishing scam, i Banking emaw UPI information emaw ruksak tumte laka fimkhur rawh. Email leh website dik lo, information lak khawm tumte hriat reng la, link hriat loh emaw hmelhriat loh emaw click suh.
4. Online shopping atan website i hriat sa leh rinawmte hmang rawh; search engine hmanga thil zawng aṭanga shopping tih aiin. Search result te hi dik lo taka hruai thei an ni a, website sual lamah an hruai thei.
